prs.title: feat(web-shell): show a dismissible Workflow chip and menu summary
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Once Workflow mode is on, the Web Shell composer now shows a **Workflow** chip in the toolbar, matching the Plan chip: hovering or focusing it swaps its icon for a close mark, and clicking it turns the mode off. If the preference is saved on but the Workflow tools are currently unavailable, the chip uses the warning color and can still turn the mode off. The chip also works while a response is running, because Workflow changes apply to the next fresh turn. While a write is pending or state is syncing, it is inert, and if it had focus when it goes away, focus moves to the composer the same way it does for the Plan chip.

The Workflow entry in the **+** menu now has a second line like Plan and BTW. When the mode is available, it says what the mode does (“Let new tasks use workflows”). Otherwise it shows the state in a few words (“On, but unavailable now”, “Syncing…”, “Needs an active session”, …). The full status sentence stays in the hover title and accessible description, and touch layouts keep the single-line row. The user docs for Workflow mode are updated to describe the menu entry and the chip in place of the old toolbar switch.

## Why it's needed

#16047 moved the Workflow toggle out of the toolbar into the **+** menu, but nothing replaced it in the toolbar. After turning Workflow on, the composer gave no sign that it was on; the only way to check was to reopen the menu and look for the check mark. Plan solves the same problem with a dismissible chip and a one-line description in the menu. This brings Workflow to the same pattern, so a saved mode, including one that cannot currently take effect, is visible and can be turned off with one click.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open a supported session in Web Shell (full composer). Open **+**. The Workflow entry has a second line, “Let new tasks use workflows”. Turn it on.
2. A **Workflow** chip appears in the toolbar next to the permission control. Hovering it shows the status tooltip ending in “Click to turn off.”, and the icon becomes ×. Click it: the mode turns off, no prompt is sent, and the chip disappears.
3. Repeat step 2 while a response is running. The chip still turns Workflow off without interrupting the response.
4. With a saved-on preference whose tools are unavailable, the chip is shown in the warning color. The menu line reads “On, but unavailable now” (zh: “已开启，当前不可用”), and both the entry and the chip can turn the mode off.
5. A host that hides the **+** menu shows neither the entry nor the chip.

Automated:
- `packages/web-shell`: `npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/ChatEditor.test.tsx client/components/composer/AddMenu.test.tsx client/components/workflow-mode-control-state.test.ts` → 346 passed. New tests cover: the chip during a running response, the unavailable marking, the inert chip while pending, focus handoff when the focused chip goes away (the test fails if the handoff is removed), and the summary line.
- Playwright `client/e2e/web-shell.workflow-mode.spec.ts` + `web-shell.workflow-mode.mobile.spec.ts` (chromium, mobile-chromium): the new chip tests, the updated unavailable test, and the mobile tests pass. `keeps new-chat Workflow informational without creating a session` fails locally with a blank harness page on clean `upstream/main` as well, so it is unrelated to this change. The `runtime` spec needs a built CLI bundle and was not run locally.
- `tsc --noEmit` for web-shell and ESLint on the changed files are clean.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Captured with the mocked-daemon Web Shell harness (Vite dev server + Playwright Chromium), not a production session.

**Workflow on — toolbar.** Before: no indication. After: dismissible chip; hover shows the status and the close mark.

| Before | After |
| :--: | :--: |
| ![before toolbar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/530b9e1e7a18b06a9ddc3d722e9a2bfe30e6649b/before-on-en-toolbar.png) | ![after toolbar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/530b9e1e7a18b06a9ddc3d722e9a2bfe30e6649b/after-on-en-toolbar.png) |
| | ![after hover](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/530b9e1e7a18b06a9ddc3d722e9a2bfe30e6649b/after-on-en-hover.png) |

**+ menu.** Before: single-line Workflow entry. After: second line, like Plan and BTW.

| Before | After |
| :--: | :--: |
| ![before menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/530b9e1e7a18b06a9ddc3d722e9a2bfe30e6649b/before-on-en-menu.png) | ![after menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/530b9e1e7a18b06a9ddc3d722e9a2bfe30e6649b/after-on-en-menu.png) |

**Saved on but unavailable (zh-CN).** The chip uses the warning color, and the menu line gives the state.

| Before | After |
| :--: | :--: |
| ![before unavailable](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/530b9e1e7a18b06a9ddc3d722e9a2bfe30e6649b/before-unavailable-zh-toolbar.png) | ![after unavailable](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/530b9e1e7a18b06a9ddc3d722e9a2bfe30e6649b/after-unavailable-zh-toolbar.png) |
| | ![after unavailable menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/530b9e1e7a18b06a9ddc3d722e9a2bfe30e6649b/after-unavailable-zh-menu.png) |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ unit tests, Playwright Chromium / mobile Chromium emulation |

### Environment (optional)

Local Vite dev server with the mocked daemon (`client/e2e/utils/mockDaemon.ts`). No real daemon or model.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the chip reuses the Plan chip's styling and its focus-handoff logic, which is now shared by both chips; the Plan chip's behavior is unchanged and its tests still pass. The chip joins the toolbar's narrow-width label collapsing like the other toolbar controls.
- Not validated / out of scope: real daemon/model runtime, physical mobile devices, WebKit. The simple composer has no toolbar row, so it shows no chip there, same as Plan.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Menu and chip text use the existing composer-only Workflow messages, with English and Chinese strings added.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #16047. No issue is closed by this PR.

prs.title: feat(verify-pr): add local Docker recipe with a host-side model proxy
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Gives local `/verify-pr` rounds a concrete, tested way to run inside Docker with the model credential held on the host. A new standalone model proxy relays only chat-completion requests, swaps the container's per-run bearer token for the real API key upstream, and prints its listen coordinates as one JSON line. The skill gains a step-by-step recipe that pairs this proxy with a Docker invocation and an in-container provider configuration, so a maintainer no longer has to invent the isolation boundary — or the credential plumbing — by hand. The CI lane is untouched and keeps its own inline proxy.

## Why it's needed

The skill requires local rounds to execute untrusted PR code inside a credential-free boundary, but documented only the boundary check, not how to satisfy it: there was no proxy to keep the real model key out of the container, no Docker template, and a non-obvious trap where the isolation gate refuses any non-empty `OPENAI_API_KEY` — including a harmless proxy token. The recipe resolves that trap by carrying the token under a dedicated variable that the provider configuration reads through `envKey`, and each step is backed by a real container smoke run rather than reasoning.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the new pin suite plus the existing verify-pr suites: `npm run test:scripts:unit -- scripts/tests/verify-pr-credential-scan.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-model-proxy.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-prepare.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-check.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-guard.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-watch-gate.test.js` — 150 tests passed (41 new), covering bearer rejection, exact path allowlist, base-path prefixing, upstream key injection, hop-by-hop stripping (fixed set and `Connection`-nominated names), gzip upstream bodies with the header stripped, pre-header disconnect abort, paused-downstream survival, slow-but-healthy streams, upstream reset survival, IPv6 listen formatting, the CLI's exit codes and JSON coordinates, `--context` head pinning, credential-scan boundaries (nested credentials refused, installed tree allowed), and the recipe's trust lines.
- Follow the skill recipe with any OpenAI-compatible upstream: run the trusted preflight with the PR clone as cwd, start the proxy from a trusted checkout bound to the Docker bridge, start the named detached container against a standalone PR clone with the base `.qwen` pinned read-only, and confirm the in-container scan and isolation gate pass while a chat-completion POST succeeds only with the per-run token.
- Negative controls (run locally, observed): `OPENAI_API_KEY` in the container makes the gate exit 4; a nested `vault/.env` makes the scan exit 1; a tree whose only credential-shaped files are inside `node_modules` passes the scan.

Local smoke evidence (this branch, `node:22-bookworm`, mock upstream on the host, revised recipe): the real trusted prepare ran with `cwd=<pr-clone>`; inside the named container the base-pinned skill hash equals the base commit's blob and differs from the PR head's; `printenv QWEN_VERIFY_PROXY_TOKEN` equals the token exported from `proxy.json`; the scan passes a clean tree and an installed tree, and refuses `vault/.env`; the gate passes in step 5 and in the round-shell shape (with the attestation passed to `docker exec`); a container POST reaches the upstream with the real key injected while `proxy-authorization` and the `Connection`-nominated header never arrive; the mounted snapshot carries all eight metadata keys; a file written in `/work` is owned by the host uid; and the checker with `--context` passes while the forged artifact `context.json` only produces a head mismatch warning.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — maintainer tooling and documentation, no user-visible UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested (unit suites + real Docker smoke) |

### Environment (optional)

Docker 26.1.3, `node:22-bookworm` container, mock upstream on host loopback; vitest via `test:scripts:unit`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the new proxy duplicates the CI lane's inline relay by design — the proxy holds the real key, so the CI lane must not execute a script from the PR-head checkout; the two copies can drift, and the script header calls this out.
- Not validated / out of scope: a full `/verify-pr` round inside the container with a real model was not run; the smoke covered the trusted preflight, base-pin, scan boundaries, gate (both shapes), relay, snapshot mount, ownership, checker pinning, and the negative controls. The CI workflow is unchanged; the recipe requires a standalone PR clone (a linked worktree's gitfile is outside the mount), and every script plus the base `.qwen` comes from the trusted checkout. The `review-pr` bot lane was red at `3509c2d1aa`: it exhausted ten retries on `API Error: 429 rpm exceeded` and exited 1 — a model-quota failure, not this diff; the other lanes are green.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

N/A

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为本地 `/verify-pr` 轮次提供一种具体且经过测试的方式：在 Docker 内运行验证，同时把模型凭据留在宿主机。新增一个独立的模型代理，只转发 chat completions 请求，把容器持有的一次性 bearer token 在上游替换为真实 API key，并以一行 JSON 打印监听坐标。skill 增加了分步配方，把该代理与 Docker 启动模板、容器内 provider 配置组合起来，维护者不必再手工发明隔离边界和凭据接线。CI 车道不受影响，保留自己的内联代理。

## 为什么需要

skill 要求本地轮次在无凭据边界内执行不可信的 PR 代码，但此前只文档化了边界检查，没有说明如何满足它：没有能把真实模型 key 挡在容器外的代理，没有 Docker 模板，还有一个不直观的坑——隔离门禁拒绝任何非空的 `OPENAI_API_KEY`，包括无害的代理 token。配方通过让 token 走一个专用变量、由 provider 配置经 `envKey` 读取来化解这个坑，且每一步都有真实容器冒烟证据，而非推理。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 运行新增 pin 套件与现有 verify-pr 套件：`npm run test:scripts:unit -- scripts/tests/verify-pr-credential-scan.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-model-proxy.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-prepare.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-check.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-guard.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-watch-gate.test.js`——150 条测试通过（新增 41 条），覆盖 bearer 拒绝、精确路径白名单、base path 前缀、上游 key 注入、hop-by-hop 剥离（固定集合与 `Connection` 点名的头）、gzip 上游响应（头被剥离）、响应头前断连中止、下游暂停存活、慢但健康的流、上游重置存活、IPv6 监听格式化、CLI 的退出码与 JSON 坐标、`--context` 头部钉住、凭据扫描边界（嵌套凭据拒绝、已安装树放行），以及配方的信任行。
- 按 skill 配方对任意 OpenAI 兼容上游操作：以 PR 克隆为 cwd 运行可信预检，从可信 checkout 启动绑定 Docker 网桥的代理，对独立 PR 克隆启动具名后台容器并只读挂载 base `.qwen`，确认容器内扫描与隔离门禁通过，且 chat completions POST 只有携带一次性 token 才成功。
- 负面对照（本地已实测）：容器内设置 `OPENAI_API_KEY` 时门禁 exit 4；嵌套 `vault/.env` 让扫描 exit 1；仅 `node_modules` 内含凭据文件的树通过扫描。

本地冒烟证据（本分支，`node:22-bookworm`，宿主机 mock upstream，修订后的配方）：真实可信 prepare 以 `cwd=<pr-clone>` 运行；具名容器内 base-pin 的 skill 哈希等于 base 提交 blob、且不同于 PR head；`printenv QWEN_VERIFY_PROXY_TOKEN` 与从 `proxy.json` 导出的 token 一致；扫描放行干净树与已安装树、拒绝 `vault/.env`；门禁在第 5 步与轮次 shell 形态（宣誓经 `docker exec` 传入）均通过；容器内 POST 到达上游且真实 key 已注入，`proxy-authorization` 与 `Connection` 点名的头未到达上游；挂载的快照含全部八个元数据键；在 `/work` 写入的文件属主为宿主 uid；带 `--context` 的检查器通过，而被伪造的产物 `context.json` 只产生 head 不匹配警告。

N/A——维护者工具与文档，无用户可见界面。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): reach the listeners the server resolves in upgrade start and verify
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`bin/qwen-managed-agent-upgrade start` and `verify` now reach the control plane, its health endpoint and the Hosted Harness where the server's configuration actually puts them. #15853 deferred this item ("base URL from `application.yml` `server.port`").

Before this PR, both phases built the control-plane URL from two `server.env` variables, `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_SERVER_ADDRESS` and `SERVER_PORT`, and took the Harness URL from `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_HARNESS_BASE_URL`. Any other place a port can be set was missed: `server.port` in `config/application.yml`, a command-line argument, `SPRING_APPLICATION_JSON`, the relaxed `SERVER_ADDRESS`, or a `management.server.port` that moves the actuator to its own listener. In each of those cases `start` probed a port nothing served, waited out `--timeout` (300 s by default) and reported a control plane that "did not report UP". The same happened to the Harness: when `server.env` does not set `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_HARNESS_BASE_URL` and a configuration file sets the URL, `start` waited on the default port 4170. Where `server.env` does set the variable, it already beats every configuration file, because it is a relaxed spelling of the property, so there the old reading was right.

- **`ResolvedConfiguration`** already prepares Spring's environment the way the server does, for the Runtime state directory and the auth mode. It now also prints three URLs, as Spring binds them:
  - `serverUrl`: from `server.port`, `server.address` and `server.ssl`. A wildcard bind is reached on the loopback interface of its family; any other address is dialled as bound.
  - `healthUrl`: follows Spring Boot's management-port rules (`ManagementPortType`). With the port unset or equal to the server's, the endpoint shares the server's listener. A negative port turns the HTTP endpoints off. Any other port opens a listener on `management.server.address` (every interface when unset), under `management.server.base-path`, and keeps the server's TLS unless `management.server.ssl` replaces it. `management.endpoints.web.base-path` and the `health` path mapping apply either way; a blank mapping keeps the name `health`, as Spring Boot ignores it.
  - `harnessBaseUrl`: `qwen.managed-agent.harness.base-url`.
- **`start`** resolves the three URLs before it changes any unit, then waits on the Harness URL and probes the health URL. **`verify`** resolves them before its rows, probes the health URL and reads the API at the server URL. The success line of `start` names both the health URL and the API URL.
- **`--server-url`** still names the control plane, for example behind a proxy. The health endpoint is then `<url>/actuator/health`, as before. `verify` does not reach the Harness, so with `--server-url` it resolves the configuration only for `--tenant`, as it did before.
- **A port of 0 or below** leaves no URL to wait on. Both phases refuse up front and name `--server-url`. They also refuse up front, rather than wait out `--timeout`, a listener no URL can name. Examples are a link-local IPv6 address, which keeps its zone, and a `--server-url` that does not parse.
- **When the configuration does not resolve**, the phases use the `server.env` URLs as before and print a line that says so. This happens when the jar refuses the configuration, or when the unit passes the launcher arguments, which `systemctl show` does not print exactly. Refusing instead would block upgrades the old guess serves correctly.

The user guide and the design document (English and Chinese) describe the lookup and the fallback.

## Why it's needed

`start` is the step where an operator decides whether the new release came up. A control plane that is healthy on the port its configuration names, reported as "did not report UP … keeps running" after five minutes, sends the operator to the journal for nothing. Worse, it invites a `stop` and a rollback of an upgrade that worked. The Runtime state directory already moved from guessing to asking the server's own jar in #15792; this applies the same approach to the URLs.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```bash
node --test scripts/tests/managed-agent-upgrade.test.mjs
mvn -f packages/sdk-java/qwencode/pom.xml -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true install
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=ResolvedConfigurationTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false
```

To see the URLs on a deployment, with `server.env` loaded:

```bash
bin/qwen-managed-agent-admin resolved-configuration
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Real host, before and after.** Linux x86_64 with systemd 257 and MySQL 8.4.6. The real Hosted Harness (Qwen Code 0.26.5) runs against a fake model. The old release (`0.1.0-alpha.98`) was installed as `systemd/README.md` describes, then upgraded with `check`, `stop`, `backup` and `install` to `0.1.0-alpha.99`, both packaged from this branch. The "before" arm is that same `0.1.0-alpha.99` with `origin/main`'s `bin/qwen-managed-agent-upgrade.mjs` swapped in and `SHA256SUMS` updated. Each scenario runs on the same host state, and the settings go in `/etc/…/application.yml`, the file `server.env` names through `SPRING_CONFIG_ADDITIONAL_LOCATION`:

| Scenario | Before (`main`) | After (this PR) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| S1: `server: {port: 60867}` and `management: {server: {port: 45049, base-path: /manage}}` in the file; `server.env` names no port | `did not report UP at http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health within 45s and keeps running` (exit 1, 48 s) | `qma-e2e-server is UP at http://127.0.0.1:45049/manage/actuator/health` (exit 0, 7 s); `verify --tenant e2e --turn`: `preflight`, `health`, `session` and `turn` PASS |
| S2: the Harness moved to port 38401, set as `qwen.managed-agent.harness.base-url` in the file; `server.env` names no Harness URL | `qma-e2e-harness is not listening on 127.0.0.1:4170 after 30s` (exit 1, 31 s) | UP in 7 s; `verify --turn` PASS, so the control plane reached the Harness where the URL said |
| S3: the unit passes the launcher an argument (a drop-in), so the jar cannot resolve; `server.env` names both URLs | not run: `main` reads the same `server.env` URLs here | prints `Cannot resolve the server's listeners: qma-e2e-server passes arguments to bin/qwen-managed-agent-server, which systemctl does not print exactly; using the URLs server.env names, or pass --server-url.`, then UP at `http://127.0.0.1:60867/actuator/health` (exit 0); `verify` health PASS, session SKIP as before |
| S4: `server.port: 0` in the file | starts the Harness, then its preflight fails (exit 1) | `start refused: The server's configuration gives the control plane no fixed port …` after 1 s; both units stay inactive |

`bin/qwen-managed-agent-admin resolved-configuration`, run as the service account with `server.env`, printed in S1:

```
qwen-managed-agent-configuration {"runtimeStateDirectory":"","authMode":"open","trustedActorHeader":"X-E2E-Actor","harnessBaseUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:53181","serverUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:60867","healthUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:45049/manage/actuator/health"}
```

**Unit tests.** `managed-agent-upgrade.test.mjs` passes 58 of 58; three of its cases are new. They cover:
- resolved URLs for the Harness wait, the health probe and the API reads;
- `--server-url`;
- the `server.env` fallback and its notice;
- the up-front refusals for no fixed port and for a Harness URL that does not parse.

`ResolvedConfigurationTest` passes 13 of 13 after a clean build; two of its cases are new. They check through Spring's own preparation:
- the port from the launcher's file, `SERVER_PORT` and an argument;
- wildcard, IPv6 and specific addresses, and the relaxed `SERVER_ADDRESS`;
- TLS;
- ports 0 and -1;
- a management port that is separate, equal to the server's (where its base path does not apply), 0 or -1;
- the management address, base path, endpoints base path and `health` mapping, including a blank mapping (`''` and whitespace), which keeps the name `health`;
- management TLS inherited, disabled and set on its own.

**Mutation testing.** Each mutant was run against its whole test class, and the source was restored with a fresh mtime afterwards.
- 13 mutants of the script, all killed, and 6 more in review round 1 (see below). Examples: each URL read from `server.env` again; `--server-url` ignored for the health URL or for the API base; the fallback notice, its server.env port or its Harness URL dropped; the no-fixed-port refusal removed; the resolution moved after the Harness start.
- 18 mutants of `ResolvedConfiguration`, all killed, and one more in review round 1. Examples: port 0 given a URL; a wildcard dialled as bound; each of TLS, management address, base path, endpoints base path and `health` mapping ignored; an equal management port treated as a listener of its own; the IPv6 loopback left uncompressed.

Checkstyle (main and test sources; a planted unused import in the test file is reported), ESLint and Prettier are clean.

**Review round 1 (`a0263bf456`).**
- **Blank `health` mapping (P2).** A blank `management.endpoints.web.path-mapping.health`, for example an unset `${HEALTH_PATH:}`, now resolves to `/actuator/health`. Spring Boot 3.5.16's `MappingWebEndpointPathMapper.getRootPath` ignores a mapping without text (checked in its bytecode), and the reviewer confirmed it on a live server. The mutant that restores `orElse("health")` fails the new assertion with `expected <…/actuator/health> but was <…/actuator>`.
- **Wording and cost (non-blocking).**
  - With `--server-url`, the fallback notice now says that only the Harness URL comes from `server.env`.
  - `start`'s success line names the API URL as well as the health URL.
  - `verify --server-url` without `--tenant` spawns no resolver again.
- **Mutants.** Six script mutants are killed: the resolver always run; `verify` treated as reaching the Harness; the auth-mode resolution made unconditional; the wide notice; the success line without the API; and a same-file control.
- **Results.** Java 13 of 13 (the new assertions sit in an existing case); script 58 of 58. The Checkstyle gate fails on a planted unused import and passes on the clean tree.

**Review round 2 (`3a57efe2e4`).**
- **IPv6 zone (Copilot).** A link-local server or management address resolves to a URL that keeps its zone, such as `http://[fe80:0:0:0:0:0:0:1%1]:8080`.
  - Node's WHATWG `URL`, and so `fetch`, rejects every zone spelling (`%eth0`, `%1`, `%25eth0`), and so does an out-of-range port. The health probe caught that `TypeError` as "not UP", so `start` waited out `--timeout`.
  - `listeners()` now checks both URLs with `URL.canParse` before any unit changes and refuses, naming the zone when that is the reason. A `--server-url` that does not parse is refused too.
  - The check sits after both the resolved and the `server.env` paths, so an address with a zone in `server.env` is refused as well.
  - A Java assertion pins that the resolver keeps the zone (`fe80::1%1` → `http://[fe80:0:0:0:0:0:0:1%1]:8080`). Without the zone, the script would dial a different address.
- **Request order (Copilot).** The verify test now lists the health probe with the session reads instead of slicing it off. The order itself is the contract: the health row comes before the session row, and each read uses the ID the previous one returned. `urls()` already deduplicates retried probes.
- **Mutants.** Seven script mutants are killed: no URL check; the health URL left unchecked; the zone reason never given; the zone reason always given; the `--server-url` message dropped; the `server.env` path left unchecked; and a control. One Java mutant, which strips the zone, is killed too.
- **Results.** Script 58 of 58; Java 13 of 13; Checkstyle, ESLint and Prettier clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux x86_64, systemd 257, JDK 25, Node 22, MySQL 8.4.6 in Docker, Qwen Code 0.26.5 as the Hosted Harness with a fake model.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** the health URL mirrors Spring Boot's management-port rules rather than asking a running context, because `start` needs it before the server runs. The rules are those of the Spring Boot 3.5 classes named above (read from its bytecode, `ManagementPortType` and `ManagementWebServerFactoryCustomizer`), and the real-host run above checks the result against a real listener. A setting the mirror misses, such as an exposure list without `health`, still ends in the old "did not report UP at <url>" refusal, which now names the URL it probed.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - The server's own `--check` has a related gap, found during the real-host run above. It loads only `SPRING_CONFIG_ADDITIONAL_LOCATION` and the packaged `application.yml`, not Spring's default locations. The shipped unit's working directory is the distribution root, so the server also reads the distribution's `config/application.yml` there. A port set in that file, while `server.env` points the variable at `/etc/qwen-managed-agent/application.yml`, gives `--check` the wrong port in its `server-port` and `session-store` rows. That is a preflight change of its own and is not made here; it is tracked in #16057.
  - A TLS listener with a certificate Node does not trust, which `fetch` refuses as before.
  - IPv6 zone identifiers, which WHATWG URLs cannot carry.
  - The other deferred items from #15853 (drop-in paths with spaces, fsync, an overall preflight/resolver timeout) are not part of this PR.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none. A configuration that resolves now decides the URLs, even where it disagrees with `server.env`. In that case the old URL was the wrong one, since the server listens where its configuration says.

## Linked Issues

Deferred item from #15853 (follow-up to #15792); part of the deployment usability plan (#12380). Related: #16057 (the `--check` gap above).

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`bin/qwen-managed-agent-upgrade start` 和 `verify` 现在按服务端配置实际给出的位置访问控制面、其健康端点和 Hosted Harness。这一项是 #15853 延后的（“base URL from `application.yml` `server.port`”）。

在本 PR 之前，两个阶段用 `server.env` 中的两个变量 `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_SERVER_ADDRESS` 和 `SERVER_PORT` 拼出控制面 URL，并从 `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_HARNESS_BASE_URL` 取 Harness URL。设置端口的其他位置都会被漏掉：`config/application.yml` 中的 `server.port`、命令行参数、`SPRING_APPLICATION_JSON`、relaxed 形式的 `SERVER_ADDRESS`，以及把 actuator 移到独立监听上的 `management.server.port`。这些情况下，`start` 都会探测一个无人监听的端口，等满 `--timeout`（默认 300 秒），然后报告控制面“did not report UP”。Harness 也一样：`server.env` 没有设置 `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_HARNESS_BASE_URL`、而配置文件设置了 URL 时，`start` 会在默认端口 4170 上等待。`server.env` 设置了该变量时，它本身就是该属性的 relaxed 写法，优先于所有配置文件，因此那种情况下原来的读法是对的。

- **`ResolvedConfiguration`** 原本就按服务端的方式准备 Spring 环境，用于 Runtime 状态目录和认证模式。现在它还按 Spring 的绑定结果打印三个 URL：
  - `serverUrl`：取自 `server.port`、`server.address` 和 `server.ssl`。通配绑定经其地址族的回环接口访问，其他地址按绑定的地址访问。
  - `healthUrl`：遵循 Spring Boot 关于 management 端口的规则（`ManagementPortType`）。端口未设置或与服务端相同时，端点与服务端共用监听；为负数时关闭 HTTP 端点；其他值则在 `management.server.address`（未设置时为所有接口）上打开独立监听，位于 `management.server.base-path` 之下，并沿用服务端的 TLS，除非 `management.server.ssl` 替换它。两种情况下都应用 `management.endpoints.web.base-path` 和 `health` 的路径映射；路径映射为空白时 Spring Boot 会忽略它，仍使用名称 `health`。
  - `harnessBaseUrl`：`qwen.managed-agent.harness.base-url`。
- **`start`** 在改动任何 unit 之前解析这三个 URL，然后在 Harness URL 上等待，并探测健康 URL。**`verify`** 在输出各行之前解析它们，探测健康 URL，并在服务端 URL 上读取 API。`start` 的成功提示同时给出健康 URL 和 API URL。
- **`--server-url`** 仍可指定控制面的地址，例如位于代理之后；此时健康端点为 `<url>/actuator/health`，与以前相同。`verify` 不访问 Harness，因此带 `--server-url` 时只为 `--tenant` 解析配置，与以前相同。
- **端口为 0 或负数** 时没有可等待的 URL。两个阶段都会在一开始就拒绝执行，并提示 `--server-url`。URL 无法表示的监听也会在一开始被拒绝，而不是等满 `--timeout`，例如保留 zone 的 IPv6 链路本地地址，或者无法解析的 `--server-url`。
- **无法解析配置时**，两个阶段与以前一样使用 `server.env` 中的 URL，并打印一行说明。这发生在 jar 拒绝该配置时，或 unit 给 launcher 传了参数时（`systemctl show` 打印的参数无法准确还原）。改为拒绝执行会挡住原来的推算本可以正确完成的升级。

用户指南和设计文档（中英文）都描述了这一查找方式和回退行为。

## 为什么需要

`start` 是运维人员判断新版本是否起来的那一步。一个在其配置所指端口上健康的控制面，五分钟后却被报告为“did not report UP … keeps running”，会让运维人员白白去翻日志；更糟的是，它会诱导运维人员对一次成功的升级执行 `stop` 和回滚。Runtime 状态目录在 #15792 中已经从推算改为询问服务端自己的 jar；本 PR 对这些 URL 采用同样的做法。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

```bash
node --test scripts/tests/managed-agent-upgrade.test.mjs
mvn -f packages/sdk-java/qwencode/pom.xml -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true install
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=ResolvedConfigurationTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false
```

在部署上查看这些 URL（先载入 `server.env`）：

```bash
bin/qwen-managed-agent-admin resolved-configuration
```

### 证据（修改前后）

**真实主机上的前后对比。** Linux x86_64、systemd 257、MySQL 8.4.6，真实的 Hosted Harness（Qwen Code 0.26.5）连接一个假模型。旧版本（`0.1.0-alpha.98`）按 `systemd/README.md` 安装，然后用 `check`、`stop`、`backup` 和 `install` 升级到 `0.1.0-alpha.99`，两个版本都从本分支打包。“修改前”一组用的是同一个 `0.1.0-alpha.99`，只是把 `bin/qwen-managed-agent-upgrade.mjs` 换成 `origin/main` 的版本，并更新 `SHA256SUMS`。每个场景都在相同的主机状态上运行，设置写在 `/etc/…/application.yml` 中，即 `server.env` 通过 `SPRING_CONFIG_ADDITIONAL_LOCATION` 指定的文件：

| 场景 | 修改前（`main`） | 修改后（本 PR） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| S1：该文件中写有 `server: {port: 60867}` 和 `management: {server: {port: 45049, base-path: /manage}}`；`server.env` 不含端口 | `did not report UP at http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health within 45s and keeps running`（exit 1，48 秒） | `qma-e2e-server is UP at http://127.0.0.1:45049/manage/actuator/health`（exit 0，7 秒）；`verify --tenant e2e --turn` 的 `preflight`、`health`、`session` 和 `turn` 均 PASS |
| S2：Harness 移到端口 38401，在该文件中以 `qwen.managed-agent.harness.base-url` 设置；`server.env` 不含 Harness URL | `qma-e2e-harness is not listening on 127.0.0.1:4170 after 30s`（exit 1，31 秒） | 7 秒内 UP；`verify --turn` PASS，说明控制面按该 URL 访问到了 Harness |
| S3：unit 给 launcher 传了一个参数（drop-in），因此 jar 无法解析；`server.env` 给出两个 URL | 未运行：`main` 在这里读取的是同样的 `server.env` URL | 打印 `Cannot resolve the server's listeners: qma-e2e-server passes arguments to bin/qwen-managed-agent-server, which systemctl does not print exactly; using the URLs server.env names, or pass --server-url.`，随后在 `http://127.0.0.1:60867/actuator/health` 上 UP（exit 0）；`verify` 的 health PASS，session 与以前一样 SKIP |
| S4：该文件中写有 `server.port: 0` | 启动 Harness 后，其 preflight 失败（exit 1） | 1 秒后 `start refused: The server's configuration gives the control plane no fixed port …`；两个 unit 都保持未启动 |

S1 中以服务账号、载入 `server.env` 运行 `bin/qwen-managed-agent-admin resolved-configuration` 的输出：

```
qwen-managed-agent-configuration {"runtimeStateDirectory":"","authMode":"open","trustedActorHeader":"X-E2E-Actor","harnessBaseUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:53181","serverUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:60867","healthUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:45049/manage/actuator/health"}
```

**单元测试。** `managed-agent-upgrade.test.mjs` 58 个用例全部通过，其中 3 个是新增的，覆盖：
- Harness 等待、健康探测和 API 读取使用解析出的 URL；
- `--server-url`；
- `server.env` 回退及其提示；
- 端口不固定、Harness URL 无法解析时在一开始就拒绝执行。

`ResolvedConfigurationTest` 在 clean 构建后 13 个用例全部通过，其中 2 个是新增的，均经由 Spring 自己的环境准备检查：
- launcher 配置文件、`SERVER_PORT` 和命令行参数中的端口；
- 通配、IPv6 和具体地址，以及 relaxed 形式的 `SERVER_ADDRESS`；
- TLS；
- 端口 0 和 -1；
- 独立的、与服务端相同的（此时其 base path 不生效）、为 0 或 -1 的 management 端口；
- management 地址、base path、endpoints base path 和 `health` 映射，包括空白映射（`''` 和纯空白），此时仍使用名称 `health`；
- management TLS 的继承、关闭和单独设置。

**变异测试。** 每个变异都运行了完整的测试类，运行后恢复源码并刷新其 mtime。
- 脚本的 13 个变异全部被杀；评审第 1 轮又增加 6 个（见下文）。例如：各个 URL 改回从 `server.env` 读取；健康 URL 或 API 基地址忽略 `--server-url`；去掉回退提示、回退所用的 server.env 端口或 Harness URL；去掉端口不固定时的拒绝；把解析移到启动 Harness 之后。
- `ResolvedConfiguration` 的 18 个变异全部被杀；评审第 1 轮又增加 1 个。例如：端口 0 也给出 URL；通配地址按绑定的地址访问；分别忽略 TLS、management 地址、base path、endpoints base path 和 `health` 映射；把相同的 management 端口当作独立监听；IPv6 回环地址不压缩。

Checkstyle（主代码与测试代码；在测试文件中植入未使用的 import 会被报告）、ESLint 和 Prettier 均干净。

**评审第 1 轮（`a0263bf456`）。**
- **空白 `health` 映射（P2）。** 空白的 `management.endpoints.web.path-mapping.health`（例如未赋值的 `${HEALTH_PATH:}`）现在解析为 `/actuator/health`。Spring Boot 3.5.16 的 `MappingWebEndpointPathMapper.getRootPath` 会忽略没有文本的映射（已在其字节码中核对），评审者也在真实服务上确认过。把它改回 `orElse("health")` 的变异会让新断言失败：`expected <…/actuator/health> but was <…/actuator>`。
- **措辞与开销（非阻塞）。**
  - 带 `--server-url` 时，回退提示改为说明只有 Harness URL 来自 `server.env`。
  - `start` 的成功提示除健康 URL 外也给出 API URL。
  - 不带 `--tenant` 的 `verify --server-url` 不再启动解析器。
- **变异测试。** 6 个脚本变异全部被杀：始终运行解析器；把 `verify` 当作要访问 Harness；无条件解析 auth mode；宽泛的回退提示；成功提示不含 API；以及一个同文件对照。
- **结果。** Java 13/13（新断言在已有用例中）；脚本 58/58。在植入未使用 import 时 Checkstyle 门禁失败，干净时通过。

**评审第 2 轮（`3a57efe2e4`）。**
- **IPv6 zone（Copilot）。** 链路本地的服务端或 management 地址解析出的 URL 会保留 zone，例如 `http://[fe80:0:0:0:0:0:0:1%1]:8080`。
  - Node 的 WHATWG `URL`（以及 `fetch`）拒绝所有 zone 写法（`%eth0`、`%1`、`%25eth0`），超出范围的端口也一样。健康探测把这个 `TypeError` 当作"未 UP"，于是 `start` 会等满 `--timeout`。
  - `listeners()` 现在在改动任何 unit 之前用 `URL.canParse` 检查两个 URL 并拒绝执行；原因是 zone 时会写明。无法解析的 `--server-url` 也会被拒绝。
  - 检查位于解析路径和 `server.env` 回退路径之后，因此 `server.env` 中带 zone 的地址同样会被拒绝。
  - Java 断言固定了解析器会保留 zone（`fe80::1%1` → `http://[fe80:0:0:0:0:0:0:1%1]:8080`）；如果去掉 zone，脚本会拨向另一个地址。
- **请求顺序（Copilot）。** verify 测试改为把健康探测和 Session 读取一起列出，不再用 slice 去掉它。顺序本身就是约定：health 行在 session 行之前，而且每次读取都要用上一次返回的 ID。`urls()` 本来就会对重试的探测去重。
- **变异测试。** 7 个脚本变异全部被杀：不检查 URL；不检查健康 URL；从不给出 zone 原因；总是给出 zone 原因；去掉 `--server-url` 提示；不检查 `server.env` 回退路径；以及一个对照。另有 1 个去掉 zone 的 Java 变异也被杀。
- **结果。** 脚本 58/58；Java 13/13；Checkstyle、ESLint 和 Prettier 均干净。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

Linux x86_64、systemd 257、JDK 25、Node 22、Docker 中的 MySQL 8.4.6，以 Qwen Code 0.26.5 作为 Hosted Harness 并连接假模型。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或权衡：** 健康 URL 是按 Spring Boot 的 management 端口规则推导的，而不是询问一个运行中的 context，因为 `start` 在服务端运行之前就需要它。这些规则来自上文提到的 Spring Boot 3.5 类（从其字节码读取的 `ManagementPortType` 和 `ManagementWebServerFactoryCustomizer`），上面的真实主机运行也拿真实的监听核对了结果。推导遗漏的设置（例如 exposure 列表中没有 `health`）仍以原来的“did not report UP at <url>”拒绝结束，现在它会给出探测的 URL。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内：**
  - 服务端自己的 `--check` 有一个相关的缺陷，是在上面的真实主机运行中发现的。它只加载 `SPRING_CONFIG_ADDITIONAL_LOCATION` 和打包的 `application.yml`，不加载 Spring 的默认位置。随附 unit 的工作目录是发行包根目录，因此服务端还会读取其中的 `config/application.yml`。当 `server.env` 把该变量指向 `/etc/qwen-managed-agent/application.yml` 时，写在发行包 `config/application.yml` 中的端口会让 `--check` 的 `server-port` 和 `session-store` 行使用错误的端口。这需要单独修改 preflight，本 PR 不做；已在 #16057 跟踪。
  - Node 不信任其证书的 TLS 监听，`fetch` 与以前一样会拒绝。
  - IPv6 zone 标识符，WHATWG URL 无法表示。
  - #15853 延后的其他事项（含空格的 drop-in 路径、fsync、preflight/resolver 的总体超时）不在本 PR 中。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：** 无。能够解析的配置现在决定这些 URL，即使它与 `server.env` 不一致；那种情况下原来的 URL 才是错的，因为服务端按其配置监听。

## 关联 Issue

#15853 延后的事项（#15792 的后续）；属于部署易用性计划（#12380）。相关：#16057（上文的 `--check` 缺陷）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): bound pending edit diffs to nearby context
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Pending and in-progress whole-file edit previews show each change with up to three surrounding lines and file-relative hunk coordinates. Common file ends are trimmed before comparing. Oversized previews explicitly report omission; LF and CRLF final-newline-only edits show a localized notice. Replacement-fragment arguments retain their headerless preview, and supplied patches and completed previews retain their existing behavior.

Diff previews visibly mark invisible characters instead of rendering them as indistinguishable source text. Both raw patches and full-content artifact views use the same visible escapes; the underlying CodeMirror document retains its original bytes. Call details apply their 4,000-character content limit after escaping. Uniform CRLF previews remain clean when their final line is unterminated, while actual ending conversions remain visible.

## What review rounds 6–9 changed

The first five rounds established the bounded preview, the visible escapes and the source-layer CRLF verdict. Three findings in rounds 6–9 were about the *price* of those fixes, and each is now paid only where it is owed.

**The merge-side escape is decided per pair, not per file.** The narrow (unified) artifact layout cannot decorate the deleted side — `@codemirror/merge` paints it from its own `originalDoc` into raw text nodes that no view extension reaches — so both sides are neutralised before they enter the merge view. That transform doubles every backslash to stay injective, which meant a regex written `/\d+/` rendered `/\\d+/`, a Windows path `C:\tmp` rendered `C:\\tmp`, and `"\n"` rendered `"\\n"` for every file containing a backslash, while the wide branch showed the raw bytes. `escapePairForMerge` now returns the pair untouched when neither side carries an invisible character and escapes both when either does. The decision is joint on purpose: a per-side test lets one side's literal `\u200b` meet the other side's escaped real U+200B and report "unchanged".

**The CRLF vote only runs where nobody decided.** Builders now stamp a negative verdict (`\diff-crlf-mixed`) alongside the affirmative one, so `parseUnifiedDiff` infers uniformity from rendered rows only for raw patches no builder produced. The inference also learned the two facts it lacked: the unterminated-final-line allowance keys on git's `\ No newline at end of file` notice rather than on row position, and a final row that kept its terminator still votes instead of being withheld as possibly truncated.

**The unbounded builder has the bounded builder's terminator gate.** An edit whose only change is the final newline now renders the localized notice in tool cards and call details too, instead of `-y` and `+y` byte-identical under a `+1/-1` badge.

## Why it's needed

A one-line edit near line 100 of a 200-line file previously rendered 201 rows. Whole-file previews now render nine rows with correct coordinates. This keeps approval readable without changing the permission protocol or tool execution.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Edit line 100 of a 200-line file: the approval dialog and pending/in-progress whole-file card should show lines 97–103 and +1/-1.
- Supply replacement fragments through the edit tool's real arguments: expect the existing headerless preview, without a claim about the fragment's file offset.
- Check a large insertion and distant edits that exceed the preview budget: expect an omitted notice rather than a fabricated whole-file rewrite.
- Add or remove only the final LF or CRLF terminator: expect the localized notice and no +1/-1 badge. Adding/removing a sole blank line and converting LF to CRLF remain real content changes.
- Review a CRLF file without a final newline: a content edit should not add terminator noise.
- Compare real invisible characters with literal escape text and mixed full-content/raw-patch artifact entries: only real characters receive a visible decoration, with matching display in both renderers. CodeMirror retains the original document.
- Expand a call whose escaped output exceeds 4,000 characters: content remains within the bound and a truncation notice appears. Embedded notice-like patch rows remain literal.
- Check supplied patches, completed previews and failed calls: preserve their existing behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The five round-5 review findings were reproduced at the exact reviewed head `e6e31c40`: seven independent component witnesses failed before the fix and passed afterwards. Six deliberate fix reversions each fail their corresponding regression.

On 2026-10-13 the branch was synchronized with upstream main `6373fc4e` in signed merge commit `e1b302e4`. The only textual conflict was the transcript bundle budget; the upstream Excel preview assertions and all round-5 fixes are retained. The transcript JS remainder measures 1,332,856 UTF-16 units, below the existing PR ceiling of 1,336,000. No additional budget increase was needed.

Frozen-lockfile installation, the complete workspace build and CLI bundle, Web Shell TypeScript, related ESLint, and the normal staged-file Prettier/ESLint commit hook pass. The six focused rendering/diff suites pass 426 tests, and the build-artifact suite passes all 30 tests.

The full Web Shell unit run reports 11,520 passed, 83 failed, and three unhandled errors. Failures were confined to the session-provider suite (82) and the settings-route development-server test (one, default 5-second timeout). A separate run of those exact files at the default timeout passes all 420 session-provider tests and 20 of the 21 settings-route tests. A further settings-file run with a command-line 15-second ceiling passes all 21 tests; no repository timeout configuration was changed. The session-provider source, its tests and the settings test are identical to upstream main. An exact-main runtime failure is not claimed, and the complete default-timeout suite is not reported green. Whole-workspace tests and live daemon/model/native Desktop E2E were not run in this synchronization.

### Round 9 evidence

Each of the three findings above was reproduced at `2d1aeb5f` before being fixed, and each fix is pinned by a test that fails when it is removed:

| Revert | Test that goes red |
| :-- | :-- |
| pair gate in `escapePairForMerge` | `ArtifactPanel.test.tsx` narrow backslash case (`state.doc.toString()` gains doubled backslashes) |
| negative CRLF verdict | `unifiedDiff.test.ts` source-refused pair and context-window cases |
| notice-keyed allowance | `unifiedDiff.test.ts` unterminated-final-line case |
| builder terminator gate | `unifiedDiff.test.ts` builder pin and `DiffView.test.tsx` notice case |

`ArtifactPanel.test.tsx` did not run when this PR was opened: `@qwen-code/sdk/daemon` had no `dist/daemon/index.js`, so the file failed to collect and the narrow merge branch was described rather than covered. The declaration bundle was rebuilt for this round, and the file now runs: 149 passed, both narrow-branch cases included. Across the seven suites this PR touches: **475 passed**, and ESLint plus Prettier are clean on the eight changed files. `tsc --noEmit` reports no error in any changed file; the 63 errors it emits are pre-existing missing-module errors for `exceljs`, `ssf` and `shiki-files` in this checkout. `build-artifact.test.ts` reports the same 8 failures with and without this round's changes, all from a `dist/` built before it.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| Windows | Actual React/CodeMirror jsdom regressions, package build and static checks; full unit result disclosed above |
| macOS | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Awaiting upstream CI |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node.js 24.20.0, pnpm workspace dependencies and Vitest/jsdom. The workspace CLI was built and bundled during frozen-lockfile installation. No live daemon, live model or native Desktop E2E is claimed.

## Risk & Scope

Compact whole-file previews omit distant unchanged lines; oversized input yields an explicit omitted notice. Invisible characters are represented visibly, so displayed escapes differ from the underlying bytes. Already escaped adapter text stays literal because its original character provenance is unavailable. No permission protocol, tool execution or core-package changes; no dependency changes beyond upstream main synchronization. The current-head CI requires maintainer authorization.

AI assistance: implemented and verified with AI coding assistants, including OpenAI Codex.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13766

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

整份文件的待执行／执行中编辑预览仅显示修改和前后各三行上下文，保留文件坐标；真实工具参数中的替换片段仍保持无块头的原有预览，不伪称文件位置。超预算预览明确省略，LF/CRLF 的末尾换行增删明确提示；无末尾换行的 CRLF 文件保持干净，真实行尾转换和空白行增删保持为实际差分。

不可见字符以可区分的节点显示，原始补丁和完整内容的 artifact 视图使用相同展示，CodeMirror 原文不改写。调用详情在转义后限制为 4,000 字符。精确 review head 上的七项独立复现先失败后通过，六个负向验证均能发现修复被移除。本轮同步 main 6373fc4e 后，六套定向测试 426 项、构建产物 30 项通过；锁定依赖安装、全仓库构建及 CLI 打包、包类型检查、相关静态检查和提交 hook 通过。实测 transcript JS 为 1,332,856 UTF-16 单位，沿用原 PR 的 1,336,000 上限。

本轮完整 Web Shell 单元测试为 11,520 通过／83 失败，另有 3 项未处理错误；失败集中在 session-provider 和开发服务器测试。默认期限单独复跑后，session-provider 420 项全通过，开发服务器文件 20/21 通过。仅用命令参数将后者期限放宽至 15 秒时，21 项全通过；未改仓库超时配置。相关源文件和测试与精确 main 一致，但未运行精确 main 的失败复现，不据此声称基线也失败；完整默认期限套件仍不算全绿。上游 CI 待维护者授权；未验证真实模型、live daemon 或原生 Desktop E2E。 第 6–9 轮修的是前述修复的代价：合并侧转义改为按「文本对」判定，不含不可见字符的文件不再加倍反斜杠；构建器同时写出否定的 CRLF 裁决，行投票只在无人裁决时运行，且未终止末行的例外以 git 提示为键；无界构建器补齐终止符门。四项回退各自都能让对应测试变红；本轮重建 SDK 声明产物后 ArtifactPanel 测试可运行，七套定向测试共 475 项通过。

</details>

prs.title: feat(mods): run prompt.submit hooks in headless runs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This is step 1 of the four in the new prompt submission design: Mods' `prompt.submit` hooks run in headless runs, for the `-p` prompt and each stream-json user message. Steps 2 and 3 add the Ink and OpenTUI terminals, and step 4 adds `$.prompt.submit`. The design document lands with this step.

- **The event fires before anything reads the prompt.** That is before UserPromptSubmit hooks, before `@` references are read, and before the user message is recorded. The hook receives `text`, `wait: false` and `origin: {kind: 'sdk'}`, in Claude Code 2.1.310's shapes.
- **A hook can rewrite the prompt.** `next({...e, text})` rewrites it.
  - The prompt that enters is the one that arrives beneath the hooks, as in Claude Code.
  - The rewritten text is what the model reads, what `@` processing and `turn.start` see, and what the transcript keeps and displays.
  - For a stream-json message that also has blocks other than text, the hooks hear only its text blocks, and a rewrite replaces them, with the other blocks after it.
  - What a hook answers after its `next` resolved is not checked, except for a drop, so a hook that only watches can return nothing.
  - `origin`, `wait` and `turnId` are pinned.
- **A hook can attach context the model reads beside the prompt.** `next({...e, context: [...]})` attaches it.
  - It joins UserPromptSubmit's context in the hidden block core already appends after the prompt, ahead of it.
  - It is escaped the same way, and recorded as hook context, so resume never shows it as part of the prompt.
- **A hook can drop the prompt.** `{drop: reason}` stops it before UserPromptSubmit and before any model request, and starts no turn.
  - The run ends with the error result `Prompt dropped by a hook: <reason>` and exit code 1. A stream-json session goes on to its next message.
  - The reason is kept to one line of 4,096 characters, as Claude Code keeps it.
  - A hook that answers without calling `next` also stops the prompt, with `Prompt not submitted: a hook answered without passing the prompt on`.
  - A hook that calls `next` and then drops fails, and its `next` stands. Handing on a drop from beneath is allowed.
- **A broken guard never blocks a prompt.** A hook that fails or times out is skipped; a `.catch` can drop instead. A failed worker lets the prompt through unchanged.
- **A prompt too long for a Mod payload reaches no hook.** That is more than 128 KiB as JSON. A transcript log line says so.
- **Only hosts that raise the event load its hooks.** The load request now says whether the host raises `prompt.submit`, the way it names the sites a host draws for `ui.render`. The Ink and OpenTUI terminals raise none yet, so they keep skipping these hooks with the startup line. A guard is never silently bypassed.
- The user guide has a new "Submitted prompts" section with the differences from Claude Code. The design document is [English](docs/design/2026-10-30-mod-prompt-submit.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-30-mod-prompt-submit.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

Mods written for Claude Code guard, rewrite and annotate the prompts a person sends:

- a guard drops a prompt that holds a credential;
- a Mod expands a shorthand;
- a Mod attaches instructions the model reads but the person never sees.

Qwen Code skipped every `prompt.submit` hook at startup. A guard that should have kept a secret from the model let it through. This step makes these hooks run where Qwen Code takes headless prompts, and sets the rules the terminal steps reuse.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- In `packages/core`, after `npm run build` (the worker runs from `dist`), run `npx vitest run src/mods/runtime.test.ts src/mods/runtime-budget.test.ts src/core/client.test.ts`.
- In `packages/cli`, run `npx vitest run src/services/mod-session.test.ts src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts`.
- Install the guard Mod below with `qwen extensions install ./guard-mod --consent`, set `experimental.mods` to `true`, and run `qwen -p 'key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP' --output-format json`. Expect an error result `Prompt dropped by a hook: the prompt holds an AWS access key` and no model request.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Headless runs of the built CLI against a loopback OpenAI-compatible fixture.** I used an isolated `HOME`. I installed this Mod with `qwen extensions install`:

```javascript
export function register(on) {
  on('prompt.submit', async ($, e, next) => {
    $.ui.log('submit:' + JSON.stringify(e));
    if (/AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}/.test(e.text)) return { drop: 'the prompt holds an AWS access key' };
    if (e.text === 'boom') throw new Error('guard broke');
    if (e.text === 'mine') return { text: 'answered without next' };
    const entered = await next({ ...e, text: e.text.replace(/\bprod\b/g, 'production'), context: [...(e.context ?? []), 'Mod context: <be brief>'] });
    $.ui.log('entered:' + JSON.stringify(entered));
    return entered;
  }).catch(($, e, next) => next.called ? next(e) : { drop: 'the guard failed' });
  on('turn.start', ($, e, next) => { $.ui.log('turn.start:' + e.text); return next(e); });
}
```

Before is `main` at `619a601b39`. After is this PR. I bundled both locally. "Model requests" counts requests to the fixture, including the background memory request that follows a turn.

| Run | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-p 'deploy prod now'` (JSON) | hook skipped (`Hooks for unsupported events will not run: prompt.submit`); `turn.start:deploy prod now`; the model reads `deploy prod now` | `turn.start:deploy production now`; the model reads `deploy production now` with the context block; result OK |
| `-p 'key AKIA…'` (JSON) | exit 0, 2 model requests: the key reached the model | exit 1, 0 model requests, error result `Prompt dropped by a hook: the prompt holds an AWS access key` |
| `-p 'key AKIA…'` (text) | exit 0, the key reached the model | exit 1, stderr `Prompt dropped by a hook: the prompt holds an AWS access key` |
| `-p boom` (the guard throws, its `.catch` drops) | exit 0, sent | exit 1, 0 model requests, `Prompt dropped by a hook: the guard failed` |
| `-p mine` (answers without `next`) | exit 0, sent | exit 1, 0 model requests, `Prompt not submitted: a hook answered without passing the prompt on` |
| stream-json: a key, then `ship prod` | both sent | the first message ends with the error result, the session goes on, the second reaches the model as `ship production` |

After, the hook's input and what entered:

```text
ui_log submit:{"text":"deploy prod now","wait":false,"origin":{"kind":"sdk"}}
ui_log entered:{"text":"deploy production now","context":["Mod context: <be brief>"],"origin":{"kind":"sdk"}}
ui_log turn.start:deploy production now
```

The user message the model received is the rewritten prompt, followed by the hidden block:

```text
deploy production now
<qwen:user-prompt-submit-context>
Mod context: <be brief>
</qwen:user-prompt-submit-context>
```

The transcript record of that prompt:

```json
{"parts":["deploy production now","<qwen:user-prompt-submit-context>\nMod context: <be brief>\n</qwen:user-prompt-submit-context>"],"systemPayload":{"displayText":"deploy production now","hookContext":"Mod context: <be brief>"}}
```

Before, the transcript kept `{"parts":["deploy prod now"]}`.

**Tests.**

- New real-QuickJS worker tests cover:
  - which plugins hear the event, and a terminal host skipping its hooks with the startup line;
  - the prompt and context that arrive beneath the hooks, and an answer after `next` that changes nothing;
  - a hook's drop, a drop handed on from beneath, and a hook that answers without `next`;
  - a downstream guard's reason surviving an outer text answer across plugins, within one plugin and during recovery, with late drops retaining the downstream outcome;
  - a caught late-drop error followed by another local `next`, with or without an earlier host continuation, and local-only recovery keeping `next.called: false`;
  - an earlier host continuation followed by a local guard drop, with that latest drop preserved when the outer hook fails with a late drop, both when skipped and when its `.catch` replays `next`;
  - a drop after `next`, a changed `origin` or `wait`, a context that is not a list, an answer that sets another origin, and a throw, each skipped for its own reason;
  - a `.catch` that drops for a failed guard;
  - a hook that only watches answering nothing, the event spread back or an oversized text after `next`, each taken without a log.
- Mod session tests cover:
  - no hooks;
  - the origin;
  - a rewrite with context;
  - a drop's one line and its 4,096 characters;
  - a failed worker and a cancelled prompt;
  - a prompt too long for a payload.
- A client test covers the Mods' context ahead of UserPromptSubmit's, escaped, with and without UserPromptSubmit hooks.
- Headless tests cover:
  - the rewritten prompt and its context reaching the send and `turn.start`;
  - a drop in JSON and text;
  - no event for a slash command or a notification;
  - a stream-json message with an image block: the hooks hear and rewrite only its text, the other blocks follow the rewrite.
- The initial mutation run caught all 21 mutants (the worker host flag, a drop after next, the pinned fields and context checks, the context placement and escaping, the origin, the too-long and 4,096 caps, fail-open, and the headless rewrite and drop). The first six outcome regressions had five failures before the fix; three further retry/recovery regressions all failed on the first fix attempt. All nine now pass. Two further regressions for an earlier host continuation followed by a local guard drop failed before the recovery fix and now pass.
- The touched test files pass:
  - core: `src/mods/` (390, 1 skipped) and `client`; the QuickJS worker files rerun with one worker (177) when parallel runs on a loaded machine timed out;
  - cli: `mod-session`, `nonInteractiveCli` and `src/nonInteractive/`, 799 passed (1 skipped before this change).
- `tsc` for core and cli, ESLint and Prettier are clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

`npm run bundle`, then `node dist/cli.js` in headless JSON, text and stream-json modes against a loopback fixture server, with an isolated `HOME`.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff.**
  - A slow hook delays the prompt, by up to 10 seconds for each hook.
  - UserPromptSubmit still runs after the Mod hooks, in core. So a settings hook's block does not turn a Mod's `next(e)` into `{drop}`, as it does in Claude Code. A Mod can tell an admitted prompt from `turn.start`.
- **Not validated / out of scope.**
  - The Ink and OpenTUI terminals; they come in steps 2 and 3.
  - `$.prompt.submit`; it comes in step 4.
  - Slash commands (`command`), prompts the person did not type (`isMeta`), steering prompts, `attachments` and `$.prompt.media`.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes.** None. In headless runs, a Mod's `prompt.submit` hooks now run where they were skipped. The terminals still skip them.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13749.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

这是新的提示提交设计四步中的第 1 步：Mod 的 `prompt.submit` hook 在 headless 运行中生效，覆盖 `-p` 的提示和 stream-json 的每条用户消息。第 2、3 步加入 Ink 和 OpenTUI 终端，第 4 步加入 `$.prompt.submit`。设计文档随这一步合入。

- **事件在任何地方读取提示之前触发。** 即在 UserPromptSubmit hook 之前、读取 `@` 引用之前、记录用户消息之前。hook 收到 `text`、`wait: false` 和 `origin: {kind: 'sdk'}`，形状与 Claude Code 2.1.310 一致。
- **hook 可以改写提示。** 用 `next({...e, text})` 改写。
  - 和 Claude Code 一样，最终提交的是穿过所有 hook 到达链底的提示。
  - 改写后的文本就是模型读到的、`@` 处理和 `turn.start` 看到的、transcript 保存和显示的文本。
  - stream-json 消息若还带有非文本块，hook 只听到其中的文本块；改写替换的也是文本块，其他块接在改写后的文本之后。
  - hook 在 `next` 返回之后的答复除了 drop 都不检查，所以只旁观的 hook 可以什么都不返回。
  - `origin`、`wait`、`turnId` 不可改。
- **hook 可以附上模型在提示旁读到的上下文。** 用 `next({...e, context: [...]})` 附上。
  - 它并入 core 已在提示之后追加的隐藏块，与 UserPromptSubmit 的上下文放在一起，排在后者之前。
  - 转义方式相同，记录为 hook 上下文，因此恢复会话时不会作为提示的一部分显示。
- **hook 可以丢弃提示。** `{drop: reason}` 在 UserPromptSubmit 和任何模型请求之前拦下提示，不开始回合。
  - 运行以错误结果 `Prompt dropped by a hook: <reason>` 结束，退出码为 1。stream-json 会话继续处理下一条消息。
  - 原因只保留一行，最多 4,096 个字符，与 Claude Code 相同。
  - 没调 `next` 就给出答复的 hook 同样会拦下提示，结果为 `Prompt not submitted: a hook answered without passing the prompt on`。
  - 调过 `next` 之后再 drop 的 hook 算失败，保留它的 `next` 结果。原样转交下层的 drop 是允许的。
- **坏掉的守卫不会拦住提示。** 失败或超时的 hook 被跳过，可以用 `.catch` 改为丢弃。worker 出错时提示原样通过。
- **超出 Mod 负载的提示不经过任何 hook。** 指 JSON 超过 128 KiB 的提示。会有一行 transcript 日志说明。
- **只有触发该事件的宿主才加载它的 hook。** 加载请求现在说明宿主是否触发 `prompt.submit`，就像它为 `ui.render` 列出绘制位置一样。Ink 和 OpenTUI 终端暂不触发，所以仍在启动时跳过这些 hook 并给出提示，守卫不会被悄悄绕过。
- 用户指南新增"Submitted prompts"一节，列出与 Claude Code 的差异。设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-30-mod-prompt-submit.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-30-mod-prompt-submit.zh-CN.md)。

## 为什么需要

为 Claude Code 写的 Mod 会对用户发出的提示做守卫、改写和注解：

- 守卫拦下含有凭据的提示；
- Mod 展开缩写；
- Mod 附上模型能读到、用户看不到的指示。

Qwen Code 之前在启动时跳过所有 `prompt.submit` hook。本该把密钥挡在模型之外的守卫，结果让它通过了。这一步让这些 hook 在 Qwen Code 接收 headless 提示的地方运行，并定下后续终端步骤沿用的规则。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 在 `packages/core` 中先执行 `npm run build`（worker 从 `dist` 运行），再运行 `npx vitest run src/mods/runtime.test.ts src/mods/runtime-budget.test.ts src/core/client.test.ts`。
- 在 `packages/cli` 中运行 `npx vitest run src/services/mod-session.test.ts src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts`。
- 用 `qwen extensions install ./guard-mod --consent` 安装上文的守卫 Mod，把 `experimental.mods` 设为 `true`，运行 `qwen -p 'key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP' --output-format json`。预期得到错误结果 `Prompt dropped by a hook: the prompt holds an AWS access key`，且没有模型请求。

### 证据（前后对比）

**构建后的 CLI 以 headless 方式运行，对接本地回环的 OpenAI 兼容 fixture。** 使用隔离的 `HOME`，用 `qwen extensions install` 安装上文英文部分的 Mod。改动前为 `main` 的 `619a601b39`，改动后为本 PR，两者都在本地打包。"模型请求"统计发到 fixture 的请求数，包括回合结束后的后台记忆请求。

| 运行 | 改动前 | 改动后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-p 'deploy prod now'`（JSON） | hook 被跳过（`Hooks for unsupported events will not run: prompt.submit`）；`turn.start:deploy prod now`；模型读到 `deploy prod now` | `turn.start:deploy production now`；模型读到 `deploy production now` 和上下文块；结果成功 |
| `-p 'key AKIA…'`（JSON） | 退出码 0，2 个模型请求：密钥发给了模型 | 退出码 1，0 个模型请求，错误结果 `Prompt dropped by a hook: the prompt holds an AWS access key` |
| `-p 'key AKIA…'`（文本） | 退出码 0，密钥发给了模型 | 退出码 1，stderr 为 `Prompt dropped by a hook: the prompt holds an AWS access key` |
| `-p boom`（守卫抛错，由 `.catch` 丢弃） | 退出码 0，已发送 | 退出码 1，0 个模型请求，`Prompt dropped by a hook: the guard failed` |
| `-p mine`（不调 `next` 就答复） | 退出码 0，已发送 | 退出码 1，0 个模型请求，`Prompt not submitted: a hook answered without passing the prompt on` |
| stream-json：先发密钥，再发 `ship prod` | 两条都已发送 | 第一条以错误结果结束，会话继续，第二条以 `ship production` 到达模型 |

改动后 hook 的输入、实际提交的内容、模型收到的用户消息和 transcript 记录见上文英文部分的代码块。改动前，transcript 保存的是 `{"parts":["deploy prod now"]}`。

**测试。**

- 新增的真实 QuickJS worker 测试覆盖：
  - 哪些插件收到该事件，以及终端宿主带启动提示跳过它的 hook；
  - 到达链底的提示和上下文，以及 `next` 之后的答复不起作用；
  - hook 的 drop、原样转交下层的 drop、不调 `next` 就答复的 hook；
  - 跨插件、同一插件内和恢复路径中，外层文本答复保留下层守卫的 drop 原因；拒绝迟到的 drop 时同样保留下层结果；
  - 捕获迟到 drop 错误后再次调用本地 `next`，覆盖此前调用过或未调用宿主 continuation 的两种情况；仅在本插件内调用时，恢复路径保持 `next.called: false`；
  - 较早的宿主 continuation 之后被本地守卫 drop，外层 hook 因迟到 drop 失败时，无论跳过 hook 还是由 `.catch` 重放 `next`，均保留最新的 drop；
  - `next` 之后 drop、改动 `origin` 或 `wait`、上下文不是列表、答复设了别的 origin、抛错，各自因相应原因被跳过；
  - 守卫失败时由 `.catch` 丢弃；
  - 只旁观的 hook 在 `next` 之后什么都不返回、原样展开事件返回或返回超大文本，都被接受且不产生日志。
- Mod session 测试覆盖：
  - 没有 hook；
  - origin；
  - 带上下文的改写；
  - drop 的单行和 4,096 字符；
  - worker 出错和提示被取消；
  - 超出负载的提示。
- client 测试覆盖：Mod 的上下文排在 UserPromptSubmit 的上下文之前并已转义，有无 UserPromptSubmit hook 两种情况都覆盖。
- headless 测试覆盖：
  - 改写后的提示和上下文到达发送和 `turn.start`；
  - JSON 和文本模式下的 drop；
  - 斜杠命令和通知不触发事件；
  - 带图片块的 stream-json 消息：hook 只听到并改写其文本，其他块接在改写之后。
- 初次变异验证捕获了全部 21 个变异（worker 的 host 开关、next 之后的 drop、固定字段与 context 校验、上下文的位置与转义、origin、超长与 4096 截断、fail-open、无头的改写与 drop）。首批 6 个结果保留回归用例在修复前有 5 个失败；后续新增的 3 个重试及恢复回归用例在首次修复版本上全部失败。当前 9 个用例全部通过。另新增 2 个覆盖较早宿主 continuation 之后被本地守卫 drop 的回归用例，均在恢复逻辑修复前失败、修复后通过。
- 改动涉及的测试文件全部通过：
  - core：`src/mods/`（390 个，1 个跳过）和 `client`；机器负载高时并行运行出现超时，QuickJS worker 相关文件改用单 worker 重跑（177 个）；
  - cli：`mod-session`、`nonInteractiveCli`、`src/nonInteractive/` 共 799 个通过（1 个原有跳过）。
- core 和 cli 的 `tsc`、ESLint、Prettier 均无问题。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

先执行 `npm run bundle`，再用 `node dist/cli.js` 以 headless JSON、文本和 stream-json 模式运行，对接本地回环 fixture 服务器，使用隔离的 `HOME`。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍。**
  - 慢 hook 会让提示延迟，每个 hook 最多 10 秒。
  - UserPromptSubmit 仍在 Mod hook 之后、在 core 中运行。因此设置 hook 的拦截不会像 Claude Code 那样把 Mod 的 `next(e)` 变成 `{drop}`。Mod 可以从 `turn.start` 判断提示是否获准。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内。**
  - Ink 和 OpenTUI 终端，由第 2、3 步加入。
  - `$.prompt.submit`，由第 4 步加入。
  - 斜杠命令（`command`）、不是用户输入的提示（`isMeta`）、插入当前回合的提示、`attachments` 和 `$.prompt.media`。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明。** 无。headless 运行中，之前被跳过的 Mod `prompt.submit` hook 现在会运行。终端仍跳过它们。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): show request success rate and distinct model colors in token usage
prs.body:
## What this PR does Makes the Web Shell token usage panel show request outcomes and tell models apart. - The overview now has four figures: input, output, success rate and output speed. The success rate shows a status icon and the failed count (for example "7 of 525 requests failed"). Output speed is weighted over every timed model, with the average first-token time below it. - Each model card shows its own success rate with the same status icon: check at 100%, warning below 100%, error below 90%. Every retry counts as its own call, the same as the daemon's `api.totalErrors`; the label's tooltip says so. A rate just under 100% is shown as 99.9%, never rounded up to 100%. - Models get six new categorical colors, with separate light and dark steps. Neighboring colors stay apart under the common color-vision deficiencies. A model's color follows the order it was first used, so it keeps the same color when the token ranking changes. The seventh and later models share a neutral gray. - With two or more models, "By model" starts with a stacked share bar and a legend. Each model card has a color strip, and its share bar uses the model's own color. Text stays in the text colors. ## Why it's needed The daemon already reports failed API calls per model, but the panel never showed them, so you could not see a model that was failing or being rate-limited. Models were also hard to tell apart. The first two colors were both blue (`#4b67ff` / `#4f94e7`, too close even for normal color vision). Every share bar faded from the same blue, and the only color on a card was that bar. This is the frontend-only first step. A follow-up will record per-request timing in core and add a speed and first-token trend chart. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. Open a Web Shell session that has used two or more models and has at least one failed API call, such as a 429 or a timeout. Open "Session token usage". 2. The overview shows "Success rate" with the failed count, and "Output speed" in tok/s. 3. "By model" shows a share bar with one segment per model, plus a legend. Each card's color strip matches its segment. 4. A model with failures shows a warning or error icon next to its success rate. Hover the rate to see "N of M requests failed". 5. Keep using the session until the token ranking changes. The cards reorder, but each model keeps its color. Automated: - `npx vitest run client/components/artifacts/TokenUsagePanel.test.tsx` (66 passed). New cases cover the success-rate thresholds, color stability across a ranking change, the neutral color past six models, no share bar for a single model, and the weighted session speed. - `npx playwright test client/e2e/web-shell.token-usage.spec.ts` (6 passed: 1200px/390px, en/zh-CN, light/dark). New checks: share segments have distinct colors that match the card strips, status text contrast is at least 4.5:1, the overview reads "7 of 525 requests failed", and the warning level appears on the failing model. - `tsc --noEmit`, eslint and prettier are clean for `packages/web-shell`. ### Evidence (Before & After) Same mock stats in both shots: five models, one with 7 failed requests. | Before (light) | After (light) | After (dark) | | :-: | :-: | :-: | | | | | ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ | ### Environment (optional) Vite dev server with the e2e mock daemon (Chromium). ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: the success rate counts every failed attempt, retries included. A request that succeeded after one retry lowers the rate. This matches the daemon's existing counter and the tooltip says so. Internal requests are counted, as they already are in `totalRequests`. - Not validated / out of scope: the per-request speed and first-token trend chart and failure details by status code. Both need new daemon fields and will come in a follow-up PR. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No daemon or SDK change; older daemons render the same way. ## Linked Issues None.
中文说明 ## 这个 PR 做了什么 让 Web Shell 的 Token 消耗面板显示请求成功情况，并让多个模型更容易区分。 - 概览现在有四项：输入、输出、成功率、输出速度。成功率带状态图标，并写出失败次数（例如「525 次请求中 7 次失败」）。输出速度是所有有计时数据的模型的加权值，下面写首 token 平均耗时。 - 每张模型卡片也显示自己的成功率，状态图标规则相同：100% 显示 ✓，低于 100% 显示警告，低于 90% 显示错误。每次重试单独算一次调用，和 daemon 的 `api.totalErrors` 口径一致，标签的悬停提示里写明了这一点。接近 100% 的值显示为 99.9%，不会四舍五入成 100%。 - 模型改用 6 个分类色，浅色和深色主题各一套。相邻颜色在常见色觉障碍下也能区分。颜色按模型第一次被用到的顺序分配，用量排名变了颜色也不变。第 7 个及以后的模型共用一个灰色。 - 有两个及以上模型时，「按模型」区块顶部显示一条堆叠占比条和图例。每张卡片左侧有色条，占比条用该模型自己的颜色。文字仍用正文颜色。 ## 为什么需要 daemon 早就按模型上报了失败的 API 调用，但面板一直没显示，所以看不出哪个模型在报错或被限流。多个模型也很难区分：前两个颜色都是蓝色（`#4b67ff` / `#4f94e7`，色觉正常的人也很难分清），所有占比条都从同一个蓝色开始渐变，卡片上唯一的颜色就是这条占比条。 这是只改前端的第一步。后续 PR 会在 core 里记录每次请求的耗时，并加上速度和首 token 趋势图。 ## 验证方法 ### 如何验证 1. 打开一个用过两个及以上模型、并且至少有一次 API 调用失败（比如 429 或超时）的 Web Shell 会话，打开「会话 Token 消耗」。 2. 概览里有「成功率」和失败次数，还有以 tok/s 为单位的「输出速度」。 3. 「按模型」显示占比条（每个模型一段）和图例，每张卡片的色条和对应的那一段颜色一致。 4. 有失败的模型，成功率旁边显示警告或错误图标。鼠标悬停在成功率上会显示「M 次请求中 N 次失败」。 5. 继续使用这个会话，直到用量排名发生变化：卡片顺序会变，但每个模型的颜色不变。 自动化测试： - `npx vitest run client/components/artifacts/TokenUsagePanel.test.tsx`（66 个通过）。新增的用例覆盖：成功率分级、排名变化后颜色不变、超过 6 个模型用灰色、单模型时不显示占比条、会话速度加权。 - `npx playwright test client/e2e/web-shell.token-usage.spec.ts`（6 个通过：1200px/390px、中英文、浅色/深色）。新增的检查：各段颜色互不相同并且和卡片色条一致、状态文字对比度至少 4.5:1、概览显示「525 次请求中 7 次失败」、有失败的模型显示警告级别。 - `packages/web-shell` 的 `tsc --noEmit`、eslint、prettier 全部通过。 ### 截图（前后对比） 见上方英文部分的截图。两张截图用的是同一份模拟数据：5 个模型，其中一个有 7 次请求失败。 ### 测试平台 Linux 已测试；macOS 和 Windows 未测试。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：成功率把每一次失败的尝试都算进去，包括重试。一个请求重试一次后成功了，也会拉低成功率。这和 daemon 现有的计数一致，提示里也写明了。内部请求也计入，和现有的 `totalRequests` 一致。 - 未验证或不在本 PR 范围内：每次请求的速度和首 token 趋势图、按状态码的失败明细。这两项需要 daemon 新增字段，会放在后续 PR 里。 - 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。不改 daemon 和 SDK，旧版 daemon 下的显示效果和新版一样。 ## 关联 Issue 无。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): put the list-failure notice under the tabs, not above them
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Moves the managed session list's failure notice from the top of the session nav to the region the sessions themselves occupy — after the `Sessions / Archived` tab bar and the title filter — and stops its request id from being cut mid-token.

## Why it's needed

#16082 surfaced list load failures, and merged. Two things about that notice were wrong, both visible only by looking at the rendered page rather than at the DOM text:

The notice was the nav's **first child**, so a failed load rendered *above* the list's own tab bar and pushed the list's navigation down. An error describing the list appeared before the list's controls, which reads as a page-level banner that happens to be 240px wide.

The request id used `break-all`, so `request-list-500` displayed as `req` / `uest-list-500` — a word broken at an arbitrary point, which looks like corrupted output rather than a wrapped id.

Both are in `main` today.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The failure surface is the deliverable, so read the layout, not the assertion. Against a 500 from `/sessions/query`, the nav's children in DOM order should be tabs → title filter → notice, and the notice's `requestId` should render on one line.

Measured with bounding boxes at 1280×800 before and after:

```
before: nav children = [ alert y=52, tabs y=180, search y=212 ]
after:  nav children = [ tabs y=52, search y=84, alert y=128 ]
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

Captured in a real browser: `client/e2e/fixtures/managed-workspace-w0d.html`, Playwright chromium 1280×800, `/sessions/query` answered with 500 and `X-Request-Id: request-list-500`.

**Before** — the notice sits above the tab bar (it is the tall block at the top-left) and the id is split:

![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yiliang114/img-host/main/assets/after-http500.png)

**After** — tabs and filter at the top, notice below them in the list region, id intact:

![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yiliang114/img-host/main/assets/fixed-http500.png)

This is a **fixture page**, not the product shell: it mounts only `ManagedSessionsPage` with a hardcoded provider, so the disabled Workspace form in the centre pane is a fixture artefact. Layout decisions here come from this component's own JSX, but I have not captured the notice inside `App.tsx`'s shell.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

✅ = the single browser capture above. ⚠️ = not run.

### Environment (optional)

Playwright chromium driven against the repo's dev server (`vite`), with a temporary `docx-preview` alias stub because that dependency is not installed in this checkout; the stub is not part of the diff.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the notice moves within the same scroll container, so no new scroll or focus behaviour is introduced; the only ordering change is that the tabs and filter now precede it, which is also the reading order.
- Not validated / out of scope: the sibling `Could not load Workspaces. …` alert is a different load path and unchanged here. The full app shell was not captured. The PR's unit assertions were not run locally — this checkout cannot build the `core` dist the web-shell suite needs — so CI carries that.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; single component, no API change.

The diff is the block move plus `break-all` → `break-words`; nothing else in the file changes. `prettier --check` with the repo's pinned 3.6.1 is clean at `3db93c42`.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #16082.

prs.title: fix(channels): allow request owners to answer one-time tool permissions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Lets an admitted Channel user allow once (`/approve`) or reject (`/deny`) their own pending tool request in the current attended turn, in both direct and group conversations. Approval is bound to the request's sender, chat, thread, and current run. Operator delegation and shared-session management retain their existing rules; the owner exception does not grant `/approve-always` privileges.

Design: [English](https://github.com/BenGuanRan/qwen-code/blob/4ff55f8afc2195a10fa8f6526e6da4c1f35717cf/docs/design/channel-request-owner-approval.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/BenGuanRan/qwen-code/blob/4ff55f8afc2195a10fa8f6526e6da4c1f35717cf/docs/design/channel-request-owner-approval.zh-CN.md). Both versions cover the same decisions, constraints, and acceptance criteria.

## Why it's needed

A paired DingTalk user in a direct conversation with `sessionScope: "single"` can receive a tool confirmation but be refused when replying `/approve` because no `operators` list is configured. The same restriction affects request owners in shared group sessions. Answering one's own current confirmation should not require granting session-management privileges.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start an attended direct or group request in a shared session with `operators` omitted, empty, or listing another user. Its sender should be able to approve once or deny it.
2. Have another ordinary member try to answer the request. The attempt should neither consume it nor disclose request titles, and the owner should still be able to respond afterward. Cross-chat, cross-thread, cancelled, ownerless, and earlier-run requests must not acquire owner authority.
3. Confirm that shared-session `/approve-always` and `/clear` remain restricted. Existing operator text delegation and native-card owner/settlement behavior should remain unchanged.
4. Reuse a `single` session first created by one sender for another sender's later turn. Only the current request owner should gain the new one-time approval authority.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the first 28 owner-approval regression cases were rejected by the shared-session operator gate before request lookup. After: those cases pass, and the complete updated ChannelBase test file passes 783 tests. Independent compiled-component inbound/event verification passed 33 scenarios, including real isolated pairing admission. A further 13 concurrency scenarios confirmed ordinary-member isolation and the existing operator delegation behavior.

Five additional end-to-end scenarios passed through the fresh bundled CLI, a real ACP child, a localhost model fixture, and real read/edit tools: direct approval, group non-owner rejection followed by owner approval, group denial, persistent/management rejection followed by one-time approval, and real isolated pairing admission. Approved requests changed files; denial completed the attended lifecycle with the file unchanged. Each scenario produced exactly one permission request. Model generation and IM transport were local fixtures, so this does not claim live DingTalk acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Unit tests, full build/bundle/typecheck, and local CLI E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ CI static checks and no-AK integration; ⚠️ no live IM acceptance |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js `v24.13.0`, upstream `0.26.5` source after synchronizing main. Full repository build, bundle, and root typecheck passed, as did the refreshed 783-test ChannelBase file, changed-file ESLint, Prettier, and whitespace checks. Independent review of the synchronized head found no actionable correctness or security defects. CI Lint & Static, TUI parity snapshots, and no-AK integration passed on the tested production head; the full Linux unit and Web Shell smoke jobs are still running. A separate comment contains the E2E report.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an admitted current request owner may now approve once or deny even with an explicitly empty `operators` list. This grants no operator role. Existing operator delegation, including its current bare-command matching, is preserved.
- Not validated / out of scope: live IM rendering/delivery, Windows acceptance, an active unattended loop/webhook permission path in the independent harness, and an all-green full CI result. No deployment or release is included.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no configuration rewrite or new setting. Routing, persistent permission options, native-card actor checks, and shared-session management rules remain unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16086

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

允许通过准入的 Channel 用户在当前交互轮次中，对自己待审批的工具请求执行仅批准本次（`/approve`）或拒绝（`/deny`），覆盖私聊和群聊。审批绑定请求的发送者、聊天、线程和当前轮次。操作员代审和共享会话管理保留原有规则；发起者特例不授予 `/approve-always` 权限。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/BenGuanRan/qwen-code/blob/4ff55f8afc2195a10fa8f6526e6da4c1f35717cf/docs/design/channel-request-owner-approval.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/BenGuanRan/qwen-code/blob/4ff55f8afc2195a10fa8f6526e6da4c1f35717cf/docs/design/channel-request-owner-approval.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整覆盖相同的决策、约束和验收标准。

## 为什么需要

已配对的钉钉用户在 `sessionScope: "single"` 的私聊中能够收到工具确认，却会因为未配置 `operators` 而在回复 `/approve` 时被拒绝。共享群聊中的请求发起者同样受影响。回答自己当前的确认不应要求额外授予会话管理权限。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在共享会话中发起交互式私聊或群聊请求，分别使用缺省、空数组、仅包含其他用户的 `operators`。请求发起者应能够仅批准本次或拒绝。
2. 让其他普通成员尝试回答请求。该尝试不应消费请求或泄露请求标题，原发起者随后仍可响应。跨聊天、跨线程、已取消、无发起者及旧轮次请求不能获得发起者权限。
3. 确认共享会话的 `/approve-always` 和 `/clear` 仍受限制。现有操作员文字代审以及原生卡片的归属校验和结算行为保持不变。
4. 复用最初由一个发送者创建的 `single` 会话，让另一发送者发起后续轮次。只有当前请求的发起者应获得新增的一次性审批权限。

### 变更前后证据

变更前：首批 28 个发起者审批回归场景在查找请求之前就被共享会话操作员校验拒绝。变更后：这些场景通过，更新后的完整 ChannelBase 测试文件通过 783 个测试。独立的编译后组件入站/事件验证通过 33 个场景，包含真实隔离 pairing 准入；另有 13 个并发场景确认了普通成员隔离和现有操作员代审行为。

另外五个端到端场景通过了新打包的 CLI、真实 ACP 子进程、本地模型测试端点及真实读写工具：私聊批准、群聊拒绝非发起者后由发起者批准、群聊拒绝、持久授权和管理操作被拒后单次批准，以及真实隔离 pairing 准入。批准的请求实际修改文件；拒绝完成交互生命周期且文件不变。每个场景都恰好产生一个权限请求。模型生成和 IM 传输使用本地测试实现，因此不代表真实钉钉验收。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 单测、全仓构建/打包/类型检查及本地 CLI 端到端测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ CI 静态检查及无 AK 集成测试；⚠️ 未进行真实 IM 验收 |

### 环境

macOS、Node.js `v24.13.0`，同步主分支后的上游 `0.26.5` 源码。全仓构建、打包和根类型检查已通过，刷新后的完整 ChannelBase 测试文件通过 783 个测试，改动文件 ESLint、Prettier 和空白检查也已通过。同步后版本的独立复审未发现可操作的正确性或安全缺陷。已测试的产品代码版本上，CI 的 Lint & Static、TUI parity snapshots 及无 AK 集成测试已通过；全量 Linux 单测和 Web Shell 冒烟测试仍在运行。端到端测试报告另附在独立评论中。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：通过准入的当前请求发起者现在即使在显式空 `operators` 下，也能仅批准本次或拒绝，但不会获得操作员角色。现有操作员代审保持不变，包括当前裸命令的匹配方式。
- 未验证或不在范围内：真实 IM 渲染及投递、Windows 验收、独立测试中的活动无人值守 loop/webhook 权限路径，以及完整 CI 全绿。不包含部署或发布。
- 不兼容变更及迁移说明：不改写配置、不新增设置。路由、持久授权选项、原生卡片操作者校验及共享会话管理规则保持不变。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #16086

</details>
