prs.title: fix(web-shell): scope file changes to the session workspace
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Limits edited-file cards and their reviews to the session working directory and excludes Git-ignored untracked paths. Git-tracked files and non-ignored new files remain visible, including temporary scripts. Managed worktrees use their own execution directory and real parent session owner for virtual subagents. Main chat, split panes, subagent details and restored reviews apply the same policy.

The read-only workspace query is bounded, capability-gated and stays on the selected local or SSH runtime. Missing or failed Git classification falls back to directory containment and retries after connection recovery. Existing transcript and explicit artifact presentation is preserved.

## Why it's needed

Edits to global memory, other projects and ignored helper files currently inflate the file count and line totals. Users need the summary and review to describe the work relevant to the current workspace without guessing whether a filename means “temporary”.

### Summary evidence

Browser E2E uses the merged compiled Web Shell, simulated session metadata/transcript/SSE/bridge state, and the actual Git route with real temporary repositories, indexes, ignore rules and managed-worktree ownership files. No model-generated writes or full daemon authentication/permission middleware are claimed.

Card and review agree on three visible files and +5/-1: source, a tracked `.log`, and a non-ignored temporary script. Ignored helpers/cache and external paths are excluded.

![Workspace file card and review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/f9a5ec02f348617c3d2f7ec657857d6f09624543/root-parent-review.png)

A virtual subagent opened in the main view uses its parent owner and managed cwd. Real HTTP 200 leaves one source file; a direct virtual-ID ownership request remains HTTP 400.

![Virtual managed session file card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/f9a5ec02f348617c3d2f7ec657857d6f09624543/managed-virtual-fixed.png)

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- In one turn, edit a source file, a tracked file matching an ignore rule, a non-ignored temporary script, ignored helpers and an external file. The card and opened review should show only the first three, with matching file and line totals. An all-noise turn should show no file card.
- Open the same session in a split pane or a subagent detail, including a managed worktree. Confirm the execution directory determines containment and Git rules even when session details are hidden.
- Reload a saved review and reconnect after a failed classification. The review should preserve its original diff snapshots, recover visibility, and avoid showing unclassified files on a cold load. Non-Git directories and older/unavailable daemons retain contained edits.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: successful edit calls from external folders and ignored helper files contribute to cards and reviews. After: the screenshots above show only three relevant files, and the virtual managed entry shows only one. A separate noise-only browser case confirms no file card. Images were visually checked and live on an independent assets branch at a fixed commit.

Validation: full build, typecheck and bundle; 2,562 unit tests across Web Shell, CLI and SDK; the real-daemon capabilities integration case; two Playwright cases; four additional browser/Git fixture groups; changed-file ESLint and Prettier. The integration baseline also tolerates the runtime-mounted `channel_reload` tag, matching the existing treatment of other bootstrap/runtime differences.

CI follow-up: Git-ignore probes now require an explicit workspace environment; a missing runtime snapshot uses an empty environment. The original process-environment guard passes without a new exception. All 58 focused tests and the full build, typecheck and bundle passed; the browser evidence above was refreshed after this fix. Hosted CI is rerunning.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node 22, built CLI and Chromium. Browser fixtures use simulated session state with real qualified Git routes; SSH is covered by automated boundary tests, without a live SSH host.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: unknown Git status preserves contained edits, so ignored noise can remain during an outage. Path comparisons preserve case and do not resolve filesystem aliases. This is a cross-package daemon/SDK/UI change; no new dependency is added.
- Not validated / out of scope: full repository suite, Windows/Linux hosts, live SSH, and real model file writes. Frozen installation did not complete because registry metadata requests repeatedly failed; validation used the available dependency tree. Supply-chain checks were not disabled.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive capability and REST endpoint; older daemons use containment-only behavior. No migration required.

Design: [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-file-changes/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-file-changes.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-file-changes/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-file-changes.zh-CN.md). Both versions are synchronized.

## Linked Issues

No linked issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

已编辑文件卡片及其评审只展示会话工作目录内的文件，并排除 Git 忽略且未跟踪的路径。已跟踪文件、未被忽略的新文件继续展示，包括临时脚本。受管 worktree 使用自己的执行目录，虚拟子代理使用真实父会话 owner。主聊天、分栏、子代理详情和恢复的评审统一使用该规则。

新增只读工作区查询有数量、时间和执行次数上限，按能力标记启用，仅在所属本地或 SSH runtime 执行。Git 分类缺失或失败时降级为按目录范围筛选，连接恢复后重试。完整转录和显式 artifact 展示保持原有行为。

## 为什么需要

全局记忆、其他项目和被忽略的辅助文件会增加当前文件数及增删行统计。卡片和评审应反映当前工作区相关工作，不根据文件名猜测“临时”用途。

### 摘要证据

浏览器 E2E 使用合并后的实际 Web Shell 构建产物，会话 metadata、转录、SSE 和 bridge 为模拟数据；Git 查询通过实际路由执行，使用真实临时仓库、索引、忽略规则及受管 worktree 所属文件。不代表模型实际写入文件，也未覆盖完整 daemon 认证/权限中间件。

上方主图中卡片和评审均为三个文件、+5/-1：源码、已跟踪 `.log` 和未忽略临时脚本。被忽略的辅助文件、缓存和外部路径均被排除。第二张图的虚拟子代理主入口使用父会话 owner/受管 cwd，真实 HTTP 200 后仅展示一个源码文件；直接携带虚拟 ID 的所属请求仍返回 HTTP 400。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 同一轮编辑源码、匹配 ignore 的已跟踪文件、未忽略临时脚本、被忽略辅助文件和外部文件。卡片和评审仅显示前三项，文件数及行数一致。全部为噪音时没有文件卡片。
- 在分栏和子代理详情打开同一会话，包含受管 worktree。即使隐藏会话详情，仍按执行目录筛选范围和 Git 规则。
- 重载已保存评审，并在分类失败后重连。评审保留原始 diff 快照并恢复可见性，冷加载不提前展示未分类文件。非 Git 目录、旧版或不可用 daemon 保留范围内编辑。

### 前后对比证据

改前，外部目录及被忽略文件的成功编辑会进入卡片和评审；改后，上图仅保留三个相关文件，虚拟受管入口仅保留一个。另有纯噪音浏览器用例确认无卡片。截图均已目视检查，放在独立素材分支，链接固定 commit。

验证通过：完整构建、类型检查和打包；Web Shell/CLI/SDK 共 2562 项单元测试；真实 daemon 能力集成用例；两项 Playwright 用例；四组额外浏览器/Git fixture；改动文件 ESLint 和 Prettier。集成基线同时按其他 bootstrap/runtime 差异的方式，容忍 runtime 挂载后的 `channel_reload` 动态标签。

CI 后续修复：Git 忽略查询必须显式传入所属工作区环境，缺失 runtime 快照时传空环境。原进程环境 guard 已通过，未新增白名单。58 项相关测试及完整构建、类型检查、打包通过；上方浏览器证据已基于本次修复更新。远程 CI 正在重跑。

### 测试平台

macOS 已测试；Windows 和 Linux 未测试。

### 环境

本地 Node 22、构建后的 CLI 和 Chromium。浏览器会话状态模拟，Git 路由为真实实现；SSH 通过自动边界测试覆盖，未连接真实 SSH 主机。

## 风险与范围

- Git 状态未知时保留范围内编辑，因此故障期间仍可能显示忽略噪音。路径比较保留大小写且不解析文件系统别名。本次跨 daemon、SDK、UI，未添加依赖。
- 未验证全仓库测试、Windows/Linux、真实 SSH 和模型写入。registry 元数据请求反复失败，冻结安装未完整完成；验证使用当前可用依赖，未关闭供应链校验。
- 能力和 REST 接口为增量扩展；旧 daemon 退化为仅按范围筛选，无迁移要求。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-file-changes/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-file-changes.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-file-changes/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-file-changes.zh-CN.md)，两版已同步。

## 关联 Issue

无。

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps the mobile workspace selector beside the hide-keyboard and expand actions, truncating long workspace names within the available space. Tightens spacing within the bottom toolbar groups and centers the context-usage ring in its touch target while preserving 44px targets and the workspace/Git components' own icon sizes.

## Why it's needed

The workspace selector and editing actions currently occupy separate rows even when they fit beside each other. This adds vertical space above the input, while an off-center context ring and extra toolbar gaps make the bottom controls look uneven.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. On a touch device or touch-emulated browser, select a workspace with a long name and focus the advanced composer. The workspace selector, hide-keyboard button and expand button should share one row; the workspace name should truncate without overlapping the actions.
2. Check phone widths, including 390px and 240px. Touch targets should remain at least 44px and the page should have no horizontal overflow. The bottom toolbar may wrap on very narrow screens; multiple workspace/Git controls may wrap within their leading group.
3. Show context usage and inspect the bottom toolbar. The ring should be centered when displayed alone, adjacent icon targets should have compact spacing, and the percentage should remain inside its button when it appears in a wider composer.
4. Show the Git dropdown. Its chevron should retain its 9px size, workspace folder icons should remain 16px, and keyboard/expand icons should remain 18px.
5. Expand a multiline draft, edit it, close the expanded editor, and hide the keyboard. Text and selection should be preserved without an unintended submission. Attachments should remain reachable in a soft-keyboard-sized viewport, and switching between simple and advanced modes should preserve the draft and attachments.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before is the reporter-provided screenshot. After images were freshly captured from the final local bundled UI using a simulated daemon and Chromium touch emulation; the workspace name and locale differ from the original report. These images demonstrate layout and available controls, not real Git operations or microphone recording.

| Before: reported layout | After: 390px | After: 240px |

Screenshots are stored on a separate assets branch in the fork and pinned to a fixed commit; the implementation branch contains no images.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Full build, bundle, typecheck, 269 composer unit tests and 22 Chromium/WebKit browser tests passed |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 15.1.1, Node.js 22.14.0. Browser coverage uses touch emulation and simulated daemon API/SSE responses. The final bundled UI was additionally checked at 390px, 320px and 240px. The Git-chevron regression assertion failed before the fix with expected 9px / received 18px and passed afterward in both Chromium and WebKit.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: narrower context space can truncate labels sooner or wrap multiple context controls; existing height allowance and 44px touch targets are retained.
- Not validated / out of scope: physical iOS/Android keyboards, real Git operations and microphone recording. The globally installed CLI was tried first but serves an older composer without this editing row.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no dependency or daemon API changes.
- Synchronized design documentation: [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/f4ee82e13d0b44668283ffa02e22f9f1b41f0e55/docs/design/web-shell/mobile-composer-actions.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/f4ee82e13d0b44668283ffa02e22f9f1b41f0e55/docs/design/web-shell/mobile-composer-actions.zh-CN.md).

prs.title: test(managed-agent): gate detach while a tool result is unknown
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This packages the FG12d cell #15750 still carried: **detach must refuse while a tool result is unknown**. The existing unknown-result arms stop at `recovery_blocked` / `outcome_unknown`; this case starts an `ext://hold` read, kills the stdio fixture, waits for the unknown, and then calls the Harness detach route.

The case requires the documented refusal (409 `hosted_turn_active`, or 503 `managed_session_close_failed` / `hosted_mcp_recovery_required`), no `mcp-release` control, and the operation still `outcome_unknown`. The Session stays attached and reopenable, so the only conclusive settlement remains the original Runtime generation's answer.

The Hosted fork budget moves by the case's measured cost: `11591 s` fork, `204`-minute Verify step and `327`-minute job ceiling.

## Why it's needed

#14447's FG12d gate asks for a detach refused while a tool result is unknown, and no class gated it. Releasing a Session while its MCP operation is unknown would let the close claim a settlement nobody produced. This change turns the existing refusal into a lane gate without changing production code.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `HostedMcpRestartFaultGatesIT` against a disposable MySQL 8.4 database with the Hosted profile. Expect all eleven cases to pass. The new case should record an `ext://hold` operation, kill the stdio fixture, reach `recovery_blocked` / `outcome_unknown`, and then receive a non-200 detach answer with no `mcp-release` control; the operation remains unknown afterward.

To confirm the gate is load-bearing, wrap `session.mcp?.close()` in the packaged CLI's close path in `try { … } catch {}` in a copy of the bundle: detach answers 204 and the case fails at the status assertion. Restore the bundle and expect green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the unknown-result arms ended at the record state; nothing asserted that detach refuses or that no release is sent.

After, locally on JDK 21 / MySQL 8.4.6 / Linux x86_64:

- New case: 0 failures, 27.4 s worst of two runs (27.4 s and 17.4 s).
- Full eleven-case class: 0 failures, 88.78 s.
- Mutation (`session.mcp?.close()` errors swallowed): detach answers 204 and the case is red at the status assertion; restored bundle green.
- Nine `scripts/tests` files that parse `sdk-java.yml`: 715/715.
- Checkstyle and Prettier: pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21.0.9, Maven 3.9.11, MySQL 8.4.6 (a disposable schema), Node 24.22.1, and the local packaged CLI bundle. CI's Hosted lane builds its own fresh bundle; acceptance remains pending that lane.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the Hosted fork moves to `11591 s`, Verify to `204` minutes and the job ceiling to `327`; `hosted-process-ci.test.js` pins all three and the workflow comments move with them.
- Not validated / out of scope: the complete Hosted lane, `check-failsafe-reports.js hosted` and the lane's cgroup root were not run locally. The lane currently has an unrelated red in `HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT.cancellationRequiresPhysicalSettlementOnMySql` (#16092); this class passes in the same full runs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no production code changes.

Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-18-mcp-release-fault-gates-d.md) and [中文](docs/design/2026-10-18-mcp-release-fault-gates-d.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #15750.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 打包 #15750 仍承接的 FG12d 格：**工具结果未知时 detach 必须被拒**。已有的 unknown 结果臂只停在 `recovery_blocked` / `outcome_unknown`；本用例发起 `ext://hold` 读、杀掉 stdio fixture、等记录进入 unknown，然后调用 Harness 的 detach 路由。

用例要求得到已记录的拒绝（409 `hosted_turn_active`，或 503 `managed_session_close_failed` / `hosted_mcp_recovery_required`），没有 `mcp-release` 控制，且操作仍是 `outcome_unknown`。Session 保持 attached、可重开，因此唯一能结算它的仍是原 Runtime 代的确定性应答。

Hosted fork 预算按该用例实测成本前移：fork `11591 s`、Verify `204` 分钟、job 上限 `327` 分钟。

## 为什么需要

#14447 的 FG12d 门禁要求「工具结果未知时 detach 被拒」，此前没有类覆盖。若在 MCP 操作未知时释放 Session，关闭流程就会宣称一个没人产出的结算。本改动把已有拒绝变成车道门禁，不修改生产代码。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在一次性 MySQL 8.4 数据库上以 Hosted profile 运行 `HostedMcpRestartFaultGatesIT`，预期十一个用例全部通过。新用例应记录一次 `ext://hold` 操作、杀掉 stdio fixture、到达 `recovery_blocked` / `outcome_unknown`，随后 detach 返回非 200 且没有 `mcp-release` 控制；操作之后仍是 unknown。

要确认门禁承重，可在打包 CLI 副本的 close 路径中把 `session.mcp?.close()` 包进 `try { … } catch {}`：detach 返回 204，用例在状态断言处失败。还原 bundle 后预期复绿。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

修改前：unknown 结果臂只停在记录状态，没有任何断言证明 detach 会拒绝或不发 release。

修改后，本地 JDK 21 / MySQL 8.4.6 / Linux x86_64：

- 新用例：0 失败，两次运行取最慢 27.4 秒（27.4 与 17.4 秒）。
- 完整十一用例类：0 失败，88.78 秒。
- 变异（吞掉 `session.mcp?.close()` 错误）：detach 返回 204，用例在状态断言处变红；还原后复绿。
- 解析 `sdk-java.yml` 的 9 个 `scripts/tests` 文件：715/715。
- Checkstyle 与 Prettier：通过。

### 测试平台

|    操作系统    | 状态 |
| :------------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS      | N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows     | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux      |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

JDK 21.0.9、Maven 3.9.11、MySQL 8.4.6（一次性 schema）、Node 24.22.1，以及本地打包的 CLI bundle。CI 的 Hosted 车道会构建自己的新 bundle；验收仍待该车道。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：Hosted fork 移到 `11591 s`、Verify 移到 `204` 分钟、job 上限移到 `327`；`hosted-process-ci.test.js` 钉住三者，workflow 注释同步移动。
- 未验证 / 范围外：没有在本地跑完整 Hosted 车道、`check-failsafe-reports.js hosted` 与车道 cgroup 根。车道目前有一个无关的红：`HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT.cancellationRequiresPhysicalSettlementOnMySql`（#16092）；本类在同一次 full 运行中是绿的。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无；不修改生产代码。

设计文档：[英文](docs/design/2026-10-18-mcp-release-fault-gates-d.md) 与 [中文](docs/design/2026-10-18-mcp-release-fault-gates-d.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #15750。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): show a Channel event timeline
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Channel events page to the Web Shell and the read-only route behind it. Every Channel now records what it did — the inbound messages it accepted, the ones it skipped and the machine reason for each skip, the replies it published or suppressed, its inbound task transitions, and the result of each poll — into one bounded journal per Channel. The new page shows those events as a cross-Channel timeline for the current workspace, with a Channel filter and an event-type filter, and refreshes every five seconds. Events carry routing decisions, identifiers, and errors only; message text is never written to the journal.

## Why it's needed

When a Channel does not answer a comment, the only way to find out why is to read the daemon log. The Channel management page shows configuration and a runtime badge, so an operator cannot tell from the Web Shell whether a notification was filtered by `reasonFilter`, dropped because the comment did not mention the bot, rejected by a sender gate, deduplicated, or answered but published as a suppressed comment. The publication audit, the inbound task store, and the notification cursor each answer a different question, and none of them is readable by the daemon. This gives the operator one place that answers "what did my Channels do, and why did that message produce no reply?".

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a daemon with a Channel configured, for example a GitHub Channel with `reasonFilter: ["mention"]` on a test repository, then open the Web Shell and click the new Channel events entry in the sidebar (or navigate to `/channel-events`).
2. Before any session exists, a notification filtered out by `reasonFilter` already appears as an `inbound` / `skipped` event with reason `reason_filter`. A comment that does not mention the bot appears with reason `mention_required`; a comment already handled in an earlier poll appears with reason `duplicate`.
3. After a mention triggers a turn, the timeline shows the accepted inbound message, the task transitions, and the publication outcome (`posting` then `posted`, or `suppressed` for the no-reply sentinel, or `failed` with the error).
4. Poll results appear as `poll` / `ok` with the notification count and duration, or `poll` / `failed` with the consecutive-error count and backoff.
5. The Channel dropdown narrows the timeline to one instance and the type buttons narrow it to one event type; both are sent to the daemon as query parameters, so a busy workspace does not have to load everything to filter it.

Route-level checks: `GET /workspace/channels/events?limit=3` returns the newest three events with `truncated: true` and `Cache-Control: no-store`; `?type=bogus`, `?limit=0`, and `?since=yesterday` return 400 with `invalid_channel_management_request`; an untrusted workspace returns 403; the same journal never appears under a different workspace's route. `channel` repeats once per instance name, because a Channel name may legally contain a comma.

Unit coverage: `cd packages/channels/base && npx vitest run src/channel-events.test.ts`; `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/routes/workspace-channel-management.test.ts`; `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/channels/ChannelEventsPage.test.tsx`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: no Channel events entry exists and `GET /workspace/channels/events` is not served (an empty journal answers 404 from the SPA fallback rather than JSON). After, with a seeded journal on a local daemon:

![Channel events timeline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/channel-events/channel-events/01-timeline.png)

The sidebar entry sits directly below Channels (the standalone shell uses the icon rail, so the entry is an activity icon with the `Channel events` label as its accessible name):

![Sidebar entry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/channel-events/channel-events/02-sidebar-rail.png)

Filtering by the Poll type keeps only poll events, and the request carries `type=poll`:

![Filtered by poll](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/channel-events/channel-events/03-filtered-poll.png)

The screenshots come from a real daemon (`node dist/cli.js serve` with an isolated `QWEN_HOME`) rendered in real Chromium over CDP; the journal itself was seeded directly rather than produced by live GitHub traffic, so the adapter's emission is covered by unit tests instead. In that run the page issued one journal request every 5.0 seconds (5 requests over 21 seconds), and the filter clicks returned 1 outbound event and 2 poll events respectively.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 24, `npm run build && npm run bundle`, `node dist/cli.js serve --require-auth --workspace /tmp/events-ws` with a temporary `QWEN_HOME`, and chrome-headless-shell driven over CDP for the page assertions. No model calls were made.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: one synchronous journal append per inbound, skip, task transition, and poll event, in the message path. Each record is a single JSON line, the file rotates at 1 MiB to one backup, and a write failure is swallowed into a single stderr line so diagnostics cannot break message handling. The read path is bounded to 32 journal files, the last 2 MiB of each, and 500 returned records.
- Not validated / out of scope: a live GitHub Channel against a real repository (the adapter emissions are unit-tested, and the page was verified with a seeded journal); macOS and Windows were not run locally, although rotation removes the previous backup before renaming so it does not depend on POSIX rename-onto-existing semantics. The page shows events for the resolved workspace only, not across registered workspaces.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No new capability bit (the page and route are gated by the existing `channel_management`), no settings changes, and no message text is persisted.

Design: [2026-11-02-channel-events-timeline.md](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/channel-events-timeline/docs/design/2026-11-02-channel-events-timeline.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/channel-events-timeline/docs/design/2026-11-02-channel-events-timeline.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

N/A

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 Web Shell 新增「渠道事件」页面及其背后的只读路由。现在每个渠道都会记录自己做了什么——接收了哪些入站消息、跳过了哪些消息以及每次跳过的机器原因、发表或抑制了哪些回复、入站任务如何流转、每次轮询的结果——写入按渠道划分的有界日志。新页面把当前工作区的所有渠道事件展示为一条跨渠道时间线，支持按渠道和事件类型过滤，并每五秒刷新一次。事件只携带路由决策、标识符与错误信息，绝不写入消息正文。

## 为什么需要它

当渠道没有回复某条评论时，唯一的排查方式是读 daemon 日志。渠道管理页只显示配置和运行时徽标，运维人员无法从 Web Shell 判断：通知是被 `reasonFilter` 过滤了、因为评论没有 @ 机器人被丢弃、被发送方门禁拒绝、被去重跳过，还是已经回答但被抑制发表。发表审计、入站任务存储和通知游标各自回答的是不同问题，而且 daemon 都读不到。本 PR 给出一个统一入口，回答「我的渠道做了什么，为什么那条消息没有回复」。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 用配置了渠道的 daemon 启动，例如在测试仓库上配置 `reasonFilter: ["mention"]` 的 GitHub 渠道，然后打开 Web Shell，点击侧边栏新增的渠道事件入口（或直接访问 `/channel-events`）。
2. 在还没有任何会话时，被 `reasonFilter` 过滤的通知就会以 `inbound` / `skipped`、原因 `reason_filter` 出现；没有 @ 机器人的评论以 `mention_required` 出现；上一轮已处理过的评论以 `duplicate` 出现。
3. @ 触发一轮后，时间线依次出现被接收的入站消息、任务状态流转、发表结果（`posting` 后 `posted`，或 no-reply 哨兵对应的 `suppressed`，或带错误的 `failed`）。
4. 轮询结果以 `poll` / `ok`（带通知条数与耗时）或 `poll` / `failed`（带连续错误次数与退避）出现。
5. 渠道下拉把时间线收窄到单个实例，类型按钮收窄到单个事件类型；两者都作为查询参数发给 daemon，繁忙工作区不必先加载全部数据再过滤。

路由级检查：`GET /workspace/channels/events?limit=3` 返回最新三条并带 `truncated: true` 与 `Cache-Control: no-store`；`?type=bogus`、`?limit=0`、`?since=yesterday` 返回 400 与 `invalid_channel_management_request`；不受信任的工作区返回 403；同一份日志绝不会出现在另一个工作区的路由下。`channel` 按实例名逐个重复传参，因为渠道名允许包含逗号。

单元覆盖：`cd packages/channels/base && npx vitest run src/channel-events.test.ts`；`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/routes/workspace-channel-management.test.ts`；`cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/channels/ChannelEventsPage.test.tsx`。

### 证据（改动前与改动后）

改动前：不存在渠道事件入口，`GET /workspace/channels/events` 也不提供服务（空日志时该路径由 SPA 兜底返回 HTML 而不是 JSON）。改动后，本地 daemon 上以预置日志验证：

![渠道事件时间线](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/channel-events/channel-events/01-timeline.png)

侧边栏入口就在「频道」正下方（独立版 Web Shell 使用图标 rail，因此入口是活动图标，其可访问名称为 `Channel events`）：

![侧边栏入口](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/channel-events/channel-events/02-sidebar-rail.png)

按 Poll 类型过滤后只剩轮询事件，请求带上 `type=poll`：

![按 Poll 过滤](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/channel-events/channel-events/03-filtered-poll.png)

截图来自真实 daemon（`node dist/cli.js serve`，独立 `QWEN_HOME`）在真实 Chromium 中经 CDP 渲染；日志本身是直接预置的，而非真实 GitHub 流量产生，因此适配器的记录行为由单元测试覆盖。该轮验证中页面每 5.0 秒发起一次日志请求（21 秒内 5 次），过滤点击分别返回 1 条出站事件与 2 条轮询事件。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

Node 24，`npm run build && npm run bundle`，`node dist/cli.js serve --require-auth --workspace /tmp/events-ws` 配临时 `QWEN_HOME`，并用 chrome-headless-shell 经 CDP 做页面断言。未发起任何模型调用。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：每条入站、跳过、任务流转与轮询事件都会在消息路径上做一次同步日志追加。每条记录是单行 JSON，文件在 1 MiB 时轮转并保留一个备份，写失败会被吞掉并只打一行 stderr，因此诊断设施不会打断消息处理。读取路径上限为 32 个日志文件、每个文件尾部 2 MiB、最多返回 500 条。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：未在真实仓库上跑真实 GitHub 渠道（适配器的记录行为有单元测试，页面用预置日志验证）；本机未跑 macOS 与 Windows，但轮转先删除旧备份再重命名，不依赖 POSIX 的「重命名覆盖已存在文件」语义。页面只展示解析后工作区的事件，不跨已注册工作区汇总。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。不新增能力位（页面与路由复用既有 `channel_management` 门禁），不改设置，也不持久化消息正文。

设计文档：[2026-11-02-channel-events-timeline.md](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/channel-events-timeline/docs/design/2026-11-02-channel-events-timeline.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/channel-events-timeline/docs/design/2026-11-02-channel-events-timeline.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

无

</details>

prs.title: fix(permissions): match amend invocations instead of raw text
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The AUTO-mode amend guard now matches parsed shell invocations instead of testing the raw command text. It splits compound commands, strips heredoc bodies, unwraps shell wrappers, skips transparent execution prefixes, and only then checks for a `git commit` invocation carrying `--amend`.

The guard still recognizes absolute git paths, `.exe` paths, environment assignments, `sudo`/`env`/`timeout`-style prefixes, shell wrappers, control-flow keywords, and `eval`. Inert text inside arguments, quoted strings, grep patterns, and heredocs is no longer treated as an amend.

## Why it's needed

Issue #13570 reported that commands containing no git invocation were hard-blocked merely because their text mentioned `git commit --amend`. This affected bug reports, tests, changelog entries, commit-message arguments, grep patterns, and heredocs.

The previous substring match was also easy to defeat through indirection. Parsing actual command segments fixes the false positive while making recognition stricter about what actually executes.

This PR addresses defect 1 in #13570 only. #13636 already fixed the destructive-denial escalation path; the policy changes for the user-prompt escape hatch, `pmForcedAsk` ordering, and `skipClassifierReason` ordering are intentionally out of scope here.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

With AUTO mode active and no session commit registered, run a command that merely contains the amend phrase in data, such as `node -e 'console.log("a report about git commit --amend behaviour")'`, `echo "git commit --amend"`, `grep -n "git commit --amend" CHANGELOG.md`, or a heredoc that writes the phrase to a file. The command should reach normal permission evaluation instead of returning the destructive-command denial.

Then try actual amends through common spellings: `git commit --amend --no-edit`, `/usr/bin/git commit --amend`, `git -c core.editor=true commit --amend`, `bash -c 'git commit --amend'`, `sudo env GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=now git commit --amend`, `timeout 10 git commit --amend`, `if true; then git commit --amend; fi`, and `eval 'git commit --amend'`. These should remain blocked when HEAD was not registered as a session commit.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A. This is a permission-parser change with unit coverage, not a user-visible layout change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Local tests were intentionally not run under the current execution constraints. CI will exercise the added regression cases.

### Environment (optional)

N/A.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: The new recognizer handles the shell forms the codebase already models. Runtime string construction remains outside static recognition, as it was with the previous guard — but that parity does not hold for every indirection form: the previous substring guard still fired on some spellings this token-based recognizer cannot see, so the two are not interchangeable and this PR narrows the surface rather than matching it exactly.
- Not validated / out of scope: Verified locally — `destructive-commands.test.ts` and `shell-semantics.test.ts` (156 passing) and `prettier --check` on both changed files. Not run: the rest of `packages/core`, the build, and typecheck; those are CI's. The prompt-based escape hatch, user `ask`-rule ordering, and `skipClassifierReason` ordering from #13570 are not changed in this PR.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13570

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

AUTO 模式的 amend 防护现在匹配解析后的 shell 调用，而不是检查原始命令文本。它会拆分复合命令、移除 heredoc 正文、解开 shell wrapper、跳过透明执行前缀，然后才检查是否存在带 `--amend` 的 `git commit` 调用。

防护仍然能识别绝对 git 路径、`.exe` 路径、环境变量赋值、`sudo`/`env`/`timeout` 这类前缀、shell wrapper、控制流关键字以及 `eval`。参数、引号字符串、grep 模式和 heredoc 中仅提及 amend 的惰性文本不再被当作 amend。

## 为什么需要

Issue #13570 报告：一些根本没有执行 git 的命令，只因为文本里出现了 `git commit --amend` 就被直接拦截。受影响的有 bug 报告、测试、changelog、提交信息参数、grep 模式和 heredoc。

旧的子串匹配也很容易被间接写法绕过。解析真实命令段既修复了误报，也让识别更贴近实际执行内容。

这个 PR 只处理 #13570 的缺陷 1。#13636 已经修复了 destructive denial 的升级路径；用户 prompt 逃生口、`pmForcedAsk` 顺序和 `skipClassifierReason` 顺序属于策略变更，本 PR 有意不处理。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

在 AUTO 模式且未注册会话提交的情况下，运行只在数据中包含 amend 短语的命令，例如 `node -e 'console.log("a report about git commit --amend behaviour")'`、`echo "git commit --amend"`、`grep -n "git commit --amend" CHANGELOG.md`，或用 heredoc 把该短语写进文件。命令应进入正常权限评估，而不是返回 destructive-command 拒绝。

然后尝试实际 amend 的常见写法：`git commit --amend --no-edit`、`/usr/bin/git commit --amend`、`git -c core.editor=true commit --amend`、`bash -c 'git commit --amend'`、`sudo env GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=now git commit --amend`、`timeout 10 git commit --amend`、`if true; then git commit --amend; fi` 和 `eval 'git commit --amend'`。当 HEAD 不是本会话注册的提交时，这些命令仍应被拦截。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A。这是权限解析变更并配有单元测试，不涉及用户可见布局变化。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

按照当前执行约束，本地测试有意未运行。新增的回归用例会由 CI 执行。

### 环境（可选）

N/A。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：新识别器覆盖代码库已经建模的 shell 形式。运行时拼接字符串等不支持的动态构造仍不在静态识别范围内，这一点与旧防护一致。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：未在本地运行测试、构建、typecheck、lint 或格式化。未修改 #13570 中基于 prompt 的逃生口、用户 `ask` 规则顺序和 `skipClassifierReason` 顺序。
- Breaking changes / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #13570

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): add host mount entries and align managed empty-state layout
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a mount entry that lets a non-React host render the WebShell without hand-drawing any surrounding chrome: a managed-only surface (`renderManagedAgentWebShell`) driven by an injected `baseUrl` / `ManagedAgentProvider` with no backend address hardcoded. The handoff is source-only for now: the mode is not wired into the package `build`/`exports`/`files`, so hosts build `dist/managed-host` themselves. It also lets the managed empty state fill its container instead of leaving a dead band under the composer, surfaces session-failure and unconfirmed-submission notices in one place above the composer without rendering the same message twice, and makes a pending prompt owned by a different conversation offer a redirect to its owning conversation instead of retry/discard from a foreign session.

## Why it's needed

Hosts embedding WebShell currently either mount only the chat surface and rebuild the surrounding shell themselves, or fight the managed empty-state layout (welcome pinned to the top, composer pinned to the bottom) and duplicated, loosely-styled status notices. These entries and layout fixes let a host mount the official full page as-is and get a consistent, centered, single-source presentation of session status, while keeping all business/backend integration on the host side through the injected provider.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `cd packages/web-shell && bun run typecheck` (exit 0) and `npx vitest run client/components/managed/ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx client/ManagedAgentWebShell.test.tsx client/managed-host.test.tsx client/managed-host.dom.test.tsx` (179 passed). To check behavior, mount `renderManagedAgentWebShell` with a stub provider: the empty state fills the container; selecting a failed session shows a single callout above the composer (not a duplicated red line); a pending prompt owned by another session shows "Open the original conversation" and no retry/discard in the foreign session.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the managed empty state pinned the welcome header to the top and the composer to the bottom, and the same failure message rendered twice (session info area plus the alert channel). After: the empty state is vertically centered and a single styled callout sits above the composer. The callout behavior is exercised by the managed smoke tests; before/after screenshots were captured locally and can be attached on request.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

bun + vitest for unit tests; a local Vite host page mounting the built `managed-host` bundle for the visual check.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the `managed-host` mode is reachable only by building it from a checkout, so nothing in CI catches it rotting. The README states that contract, and `files` keeps `dist/types/managed-host.d.ts` out of the published package so the package does not advertise a type with no implementation.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows and Linux; a real daemon or Managed runtime (verified against a stub/local bridge). Current head includes a merge from `main` and GitHub reports it as mergeable.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `ManagedAgentProvider.submitPrompt` now resolves `operationId?: string` instead of `operationId: string` — hosts that read `operationId` must handle its absence; existing providers stay assignable, only strict readers are affected. Everything else is additive for existing consumers. The foreign-session pending redirect intentionally changes cross-session retry UX (a foreign session now redirects to the owner instead of retrying in place).

Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-host-webshell.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-host-webshell.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

新增挂载入口，让非 React 宿主无需自绘外壳即可渲染 WebShell：仅托管会话的入口（`renderManagedAgentWebShell`），由宿主注入的 `baseUrl` / `ManagedAgentProvider` 驱动，不内置任何后端地址。该入口目前只随源码提供：没有接入包的 `build`/`exports`/`files`，构建 `dist/managed-host` 由宿主自行完成。同时托管空态改为铺满容器，不再在 composer 下方留出死区；将会话失败与未确认提交的提示统一放到 composer 上方、同一消息不再重复渲染；当未决提交属于另一个会话时，改为提供"返回原会话"的跳转，而不是在外会话里重试/丢弃。

## 为什么需要

嵌入 WebShell 的宿主目前要么只挂聊天界面、自己重绘外围外壳，要么忍受托管空态布局（欢迎头顶在上、输入框贴在下）以及重复、样式松散的状态提示。这些入口与布局修复让宿主能原样挂载官方整页，获得一致、居中、单一来源的会话状态呈现，同时把所有业务/后端集成留在宿主侧、通过注入的 provider 完成。

## 评审验证方案

运行 `cd packages/web-shell && bun run typecheck`（退出码 0）与 `npx vitest run client/components/managed/ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx client/ManagedAgentWebShell.test.tsx client/managed-host.test.tsx client/managed-host.dom.test.tsx`（179 通过）。行为验证：用 stub provider 挂载 `renderManagedAgentWebShell`，空态铺满容器；选中失败会话时 composer 上方只显示一条提示（不再重复红字）；未决提交属于其他会话时显示"返回原会话"，外会话中不出现重试/丢弃。

### 前后对比

改动前：托管空态把欢迎头钉在顶部、输入框贴在底部，同一条失败消息渲染两次（会话信息区 + 告警通道）。改动后：空态垂直居中，composer 上方只有一条带样式的提示。提示行为已由托管场景 smoke 测试覆盖；前后截图已在本地留存，可按需附上。

### 测试环境

macOS 已测；Windows / Linux 未测。bun + vitest 跑单测，本地 Vite 宿主页挂载构建出的 `managed-host` 产物做视觉验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：`managed-host` 模式只能从源码 checkout 手动构建，CI 不会发现它腐坏。README 已写明这一约定，`files` 也把 `dist/types/managed-host.d.ts` 排除在发布产物之外，避免包内出现没有实现的类型。
- 未验证/范围外：Windows 与 Linux；真实 daemon 或托管运行时（用 stub/本地桥验证）。当前 head 已包含一次 `main` 合并，GitHub 显示可合并。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：对现有使用者无破坏，入口为新增。外会话未决跳转有意改变了跨会话重试交互（外会话改为跳转到归属会话，而非就地重试）。

设计文档：[英文](docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-host-webshell.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-host-webshell.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): keep javadoc valid after the module split
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Two javadoc defects left behind by the Maven module split are repaired so that the release profile builds again: the ECMAScript number formatter no longer writes a bare `<` before `1e21` in its documentation (it is escaped, so doclint stops reading it as the start of an HTML tag), and the external runtime provisioner now imports the kinds class its documentation links to, a link that had resolved only because both used to share a package.

## Why it's needed

The release workflow is the only place that runs javadoc, through the `central-release` profile, so neither defect could have failed a pull request. When `v0.26.5` was published, the job that verifies the executable JAR and the publication profile stopped on the first of them and every later step was skipped — attaching the artifact to the GitHub release and uploading it to the download mirror. The result is that `v0.26.5` has no managed runtime artifact at all, and `qwen serve --managed` on top of that CLI version cannot bootstrap. The same build fails identically on the next release until these two comments are fixed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Install the sibling SDK from the same source first, then run the release profile build. On `main` it stops in the contracts module; on this branch the whole reactor completes and produces the executable JAR.

```bash
mvn -f packages/sdk-java/qwencode/pom.xml clean install -Dgpg.skip=true -DskipTests
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml clean package -Pcentral-release -Dgpg.skip=true -DskipTests
```

### How to verify

Run the two commands above on both branches and compare the outcome. Expected on `main`: `malformed HTML` at the number formatter's comment, and after that one is bypassed, `reference not found` at the provisioner's class comment. Expected on this branch: `BUILD SUCCESS` for all eight modules, with `server/target/qwen-managed-agent-server-*-exec.jar` carrying `Main-Class: org.springframework.boot.loader.launch.JarLauncher`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

prs.title: feat(web-shell): surface session rename inline and add F2 shortcut
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes renaming a session in the Web Shell sidebar easier to find. Rename now shows as a pencil button next to pin when you hover a session row, instead of being hidden in the ⋯ menu, and pressing F2 on a focused session row opens the same inline rename editor. Opening a session by click and rename by double-click behave exactly as before.

## Why it's needed

Rename was only reachable through hover → ⋯ → Rename or an undocumented double-click, which makes it hard to discover and slow when organizing a busy sidebar. This implements the reshaped scope the triage on #14327 agreed to (an inline row action and an F2 shortcut) instead of single-click-to-rename, which would conflict with opening a session.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the Web Shell and hover any session row: a pencil (Rename) button now sits next to pin. Click it and the inline editor opens with the current title.
2. Tab to a session row and press F2: the same editor opens, and the session is not opened.
3. Press F2 while the cursor is inside the rename input or on a row button: nothing extra happens (the handler only fires when the row itself is focused).
4. Confirm Enter on a focused row still opens the session, and double-click still renames.
5. Consumers that pass `sessionActions.inlineItems` explicitly keep their current layout.

Automated: `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/sidebar` → 27 files, 550 tests pass. The new F2 test fails without the change. ESLint, Prettier and `tsc --noEmit` are clean.

No screenshots yet: I verified through the component test suite (jsdom). I can attach a before/after recording of the hover slot and F2 if a maintainer wants one.

prs.title: test(install): pin Windows PATH persistence contract
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a focused source-contract test for Windows standalone installation so the persistent user or machine PATH update remains covered even though every Windows end-to-end fixture intentionally suppresses that write. The test pins the production gate, the install-bin argument handed to the final installer step, the selected PATH scope, and the PowerShell write-back that avoids `setx` truncation.

## Why it's needed

The existing isolation correctly prevents tests from mutating the runner account's persistent PATH, but after that isolation the suite only asserted that no PATH write happened. A regression in the gated write path could therefore remove a fresh installation from the user's PATH without making any check fail. This keeps the isolation while restoring a behavioural contract at the batch-script boundary.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the installer test suite and confirm the new contract test passes. Then mutate any of the pinned statements in the Windows standalone installer, such as changing the enabled branch from `User` to `Machine`, dropping the install-bin argument, or bypassing the PowerShell write-back. The new test should fail for each mutation while the existing no-persistent-write assertion remains green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change; no user-visible surface. Before this patch, the enabled PATH-write path had only negative coverage because the Windows E2E harness always injected the no-modify flag. After this patch, the gated call and write semantics are pinned directly.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment

No local tests, build, lint, format, or typecheck were run for this change; validation is deferred to CI under the execution constraint for this batch.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the check pins batch source text rather than executing a real PowerShell PATH write, trading runtime fidelity for complete isolation from the runner account.
- Not validated / out of scope: a live Windows registry write; item 1 is covered separately by #16009.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Addresses item 2 of #15895. Item 1 is covered by #16009, so this PR intentionally does not auto-close the issue.

prs.title: fix(core): keep Write deny rules when quoting hides the async operator
prs.body:
## Linked Issues

Fixes #12246.

## What

`cd .qwen ; cd 'x\'';echo ' & echo {} > settings.json` with `deny: ["Write(.qwen/settings.json)"]` evaluated to `allow` and overwrote the protected file with no prompt. The second `cd` is backgrounded by the real ` & ` (bash reads `'x\''` + `';echo '` as one concatenated argument), but the permission splitter read a `;` between the two quote fragments, treated the `cd` as foreground, moved the effective cwd, and the write resolved to the wrong path — so the deny rule never saw it.

Verified live against bash: the payload above really does write `.qwen/settings.json`.

## Root cause

The two backslash readings disagree on where the operators are: the escape-everywhere reading sees a `;` inside what bash treats as one quoted word. A boundary only one reading sees cannot be allowed to decide a `cd`'s foreground/background effect on its own, and mixing both readings' boundaries into one split invents phantom `cd` targets no shell produces.

## Fix

Built on top of #11765's dual-reading splitter:

- `splitCompoundCommandSegmentsForReading(command, reading)` exposes one reading's split next to the union default (rule-parser). The union split stays the default for boundary discovery.
- `extractShellOperationsAcrossCommand` walks each self-consistent reading separately when a backslash is present and merges the operation sets (deduped); for cwd attribution the walker needs each reading's own split, since the union's mixed boundaries would attribute writes to phantom cwds. The permission layer aggregates to the most restrictive verdict, so a boundary only one reading sees can no longer move a write away from the protected path.
- `isDynamicShellPath` also escalates `cd` targets carrying shell metacharacters (`;|&><`), which can only be quoting artifacts of a split.

## Reviewer Test Plan

```bash
npx vitest run packages/core/src/permissions --reporter=dot
```

New pins:

- `shell-semantics.test.ts`: the exploit shape attributes the write to `/repo/.qwen/settings.json` (the bash-correct path); a quoting-artifact `cd` target escalates to `cwdUnknown` instead of becoming a phantom cwd.
- `permission-manager.test.ts`: the issue's exact rule config returns `deny` for the exploit and both controls keep `deny`; the single-reading split is pinned directly for both the plain-quote and ANSI-C cases.
- R9 round: a trailing continuation backslash no longer becomes a phantom `cd` operand, and a comment marker glued to `$()`, `$((...))`, `<()` or `>()` stays inside the same word so the following line is not re-rooted.

## Merged main

`7b9dceca4e` merges `main` through `7b4b353750` and clears the conflict GitHub reported. The one real conflict was in `shell-semantics.ts`, and it was architectural rather than textual: upstream #15681 rewrote the redirect tokenizer to track which characters were typed unquoted and to treat `2>&1` / `>&-` as descriptor operations, while this branch already carries per-character bare/quoted state on each `ShellToken`. Both answer the same question, with two representations.

I kept the `ShellToken` representation and ported upstream's descriptor semantics onto it, since it already has the quoting detail upstream needed `fdRedirects`/`fdCloses` out-params for:

- `redirectTargetFile` decides what a target names. A bare `&` followed by a number or `-` is a descriptor and opens nothing, `/dev/null` and the `/dev/tcp`/`/dev/udp` pseudo-devices open nothing, and anything else names a file without the `&`. An unquoted `-` after a bare `&` is a close, so the redirect token keeps the whole `&-word`; a quoted or escaped `-` is part of the name and is reported without the flag check that would drop it.
- `pushToken` walks an `>&-` chain in a loop, so a long one cannot overflow the stack, and only the first redirect keeps the whole word.
- A bare `&` inside a word is what makes the two readings of `2">"&1` disagree, so that shape still reports the literal `&1` write. A fully quoted word (`cd '>y'`) has no bare syntax and stays an operand, which this branch's R3-1 rows pin.

Nothing in #12246 is superseded by #15681; they are different bugs that met in the same tokenizer.

## Tested

| OS | Result |
| --- | --- |
| macOS arm64 | `7b9dceca4e`: `packages/core/src/permissions` 1501/1501 across 16 files, which is upstream's fd-duplication rows and this branch's R3/R7/R9 rows together; `tsc --noEmit -p packages/core` clean; eslint clean on the touched file |

Wider `packages/core` on this merge is 40293 passed with 6 failures in unrelated subsystems: packaging asset counts, a memory recall scan timing ceiling, git commit tracking, a pull refusal message, the Anthropic user-agent identity and an omni preset path that resolves outside the repo. None of them import `permissions/shell-semantics`, and I did not re-baseline them against `main`.

The earlier head `b381c0628d` was 1394/1394 on the permissions suite before upstream's tokenizer landed.

## Risk & Scope

Core permission path, small scope. The dual-reading evaluation only engages when the command contains a backslash; other commands take the identical path as before. The three `echo 'a\' # ...` comment rows settle at `ask` (fail-closed), matching upstream's existing expectation for the ambiguous shape.

## Out of scope

- Converging the two segmentations themselves (#11882 umbrella).
- No changes to the `Write` rule matcher or deny syntax.

## Affiliation

Individual contributor (not affiliated with Moonshot AI).

## What this PR does

Aligns the portability example supplied to review agents with the current macOS execution job, its scripts group and all three admitted events. Refreshes related comments while preserving the historical example's context.

## Why it's needed

The example still describes the aggregate job as the test executor and cites an obsolete command chain. Reviewers following that example could cite a lane that does not execute the affected script.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Generate a review plan for a CI diff with `node dist/cli.js review plan-diff <ci.diff> --out <plan.json>`, then generate the actual brief with `node dist/cli.js review agent-prompt --plan <plan.json> --chunk 1`. A plain-TypeScript control should receive no shell-lane checklist. Compare these claims against the workflow and group runner; CI execution logic should remain unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal review instructions and comments; no UI change. Two deterministic source/workflow consistency checks fail on the baseline and pass with the patch; five additional contract checks pass. The existing path-rule suite passes 243/243 tests. The rebuilt CLI succeeds in five actual invocations covering its version, CI-diff plan and brief, and plain-TypeScript control plan and brief.

Windows build, bundle and typecheck pass. Linux format, lint, build and typecheck pass; the affected path-rule suite passes 243/243 tests, all 13 script suites directly referencing the CI workflow pass with 1,186 tests passed and 1 skipped, and the build/bundle/startup-closure gate passes.

A complete `npm run preflight` is not reported as passing: the broad workspace sweep was incomplete, and the standalone-runtime download failed because `nodejs.org` could not be resolved in this environment. The results above are change-scoped checks.

Validated source baseline: `bd0950774eb1385017d2ea3d60dc4689806e00fd`. Node.js 24.15.0 and pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Linux uses Ubuntu 24.04 on WSL, one Vitest worker and a private PID namespace for the orphan-reaping fixture; recovery runs use `CI=true` and a 4GB Node heap. No model or provider requests were made.

- Main risk or tradeoff: the worked example remains tied to repository CI names and commands.
- Not validated / out of scope: live macOS execution and model review; item 2's Windows installer PATH coverage gap.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

AI assisted the investigation, edit and validation.

prs.title: feat(acp): run re-entered, channel and Goal-proposal turns on the shared loop
prs.body:
## What this PR does

With `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` on, five more kinds of ACP turn now run on the shared round, the shared tool batch and the client's stop point. This is PR 2c-2 of #15327.

Two of them are fresh prompts that PR 2a left out:

- A **channel prompt** is a `UserQuery` like any fresh prompt. As today, it carries no submitted prompt or workflow input, its responses are not cut short by queued input, its tool results never end the turn, and its repeated-tool-failure guard stays off.
- A **Goal-proposal approval turn** is a `UserQuery`. The session settles the proposal as today. When the Todo Stop Guard gives way or the Stop hook reaches its cap, the proposal does not start a Goal, as the session's own Stop loop does.

Three of them re-enter a turn the session already has:

- A **retry**: ACP still strips the failed attempt, and puts it back if the retry never sends. The first round is a `Retry` that carries the attempt's history identity and UserPromptSubmit's verdict from `admitUserPrompt`, so the hook still runs on a retry.
- A **continue** of an interrupted turn: ACP still strips the interrupted user run, or closes the interrupted calls. The first round is a `Retry` with the history identity and without UserPromptSubmit, as today. A first request that never goes out puts the interrupted run back as it was.
- The **restore** of an unanswered `ask_user_question`: ACP asks the question again with its own tool step. The answer goes out as the first round, a `Retry`, and later batches run on the shared batch.

A re-entered turn's first round is a `Retry` even when it carries tool results. A `ToolResult` does not start the client's interaction, so the previous prompt's loop-detector counts would carry over, and UserPromptSubmit would run on the results. The client adds no system reminders to a `Retry`, so ACP still adds its plan, arena and output-style reminders.

The restored question keeps ACP's tool step for now. The shared batch records every result, but a question left unanswered on a timeout must stay unrecorded so that a later load can ask it again.

Core changes:

- `SendMessageOptions.userTurnRecordedByHost` also covers a `Retry`, whose todo work chain the host started.
- `promptAdmission` is accepted on a `Retry`.
- New input `historyPromptId`: the history identity a `Retry`'s request carries. Its first request uses it up, so continuations do not carry it along.

With the setting on, these turns differ from today in the ways the design's Compatibility section lists:

- Channel and Goal-proposal turns get what any fresh prompt gets on the shared path, such as the date and system reminders and the client's recall.
- A retry, a continue and a restore start the client's interaction: the loop detector, exploration budget and turn budget start over. Their first round does not count toward the session turn cap.
- A continue whose first request never goes out puts the interrupted user run back as it was, instead of keeping one merged entry.

## Why it's needed

Only fresh prompts outside channels and Goal proposals used the shared loop. Retries, continues and restores still ran ACP's legacy send path, stop loop and tool step, and channel and Goal-proposal turns did too. Each of these copies would need every loop fix again.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run `npm run bundle`, then `cd integration-tests && npx vitest run cli/acp-agent-loop-parity.test.ts`.
  - The new scenarios "a channel prompt that reads a file" and "a retry after a model error" must send the model the same requests with the setting off and on, and produce the same `session/update` notifications and stop reasons. The other scenarios must be unchanged.
- Unit tests:
  - `packages/core` `client.test.ts`:
    - an admission spent by a `Retry`;
    - a `Retry` marked with the identity the host gives it;
    - a retry's todo work chain left to the host.
  - `packages/cli` `Session.test.ts`:
    - a channel prompt on the shared round;
    - a Goal proposal kept from starting once the guard gave way;
    - retry and continue sent as a `Retry` with the stripped identity;
    - the stripped prompt put back once when the first request fails or is cancelled before it goes out;
    - a restored question answered by ACP's executor and sent as a `Retry`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: the change is behind an off-by-default setting, and the parity suite compares both loops.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local results on Linux:

- ACP parity suite 21/21 and headless parity suite 12/12, from a fresh `npm run bundle`
- root `npm run typecheck` (all workspaces and `typecheck:integration`) passes
- core `client.test.ts` and `agent-loop.test.ts`: 627 passed
- cli `src/acp-integration/`: 3,154 passed; the one failure is `acp-output.test.ts`, a Node stream test this PR does not touch, which fails the same way without this PR
- eslint and prettier clean on the changed files

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: retries, continues and restores now take the client's per-interaction state, so their loop detector and budgets start over. The first round of a restore keeps ACP's executor until a later step teaches the shared batch to leave an unattended answer unrecorded. With the setting off, nothing changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: Goal turns (PR 2c-3), and cron and background-notification turns (PR 2c-4).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design: [docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md) and [docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md). Both have the new PR 2c-2 section, the widened `userTurnRecordedByHost` row, `historyPromptId` among the inputs, the new ACP scenarios and the intended differences.

## Linked Issues

Part of #15327.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

开启 `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` 后，又有五类 ACP 轮次改为使用共享模型轮、共享工具批和 client 的 stop 点。这是 #15327 的 PR 2c-2。

其中两类是 PR 2a 没有纳入的全新 prompt：

- **channel prompt** 与其他全新 prompt 一样是 `UserQuery`。和现在一样，它不带 submitted prompt 和 workflow 输入，它的回复不会被排队的输入打断，它的工具结果从不结束这一轮，重复工具失败守卫保持关闭。
- **Goal 提案审批轮次**是 `UserQuery`。会话和现在一样结算提案。Todo Stop Guard 让位或 Stop hook 达到上限时，提案不会启动 Goal，这和会话自己的 Stop 循环一致。

另外三类重新进入会话中已有的轮次：

- **retry**：仍由 ACP 剥离失败的那次尝试，retry 一直没有发出时再把它放回。第一轮是 `Retry`，带上那次尝试的历史标识，以及 `admitUserPrompt` 给出的 UserPromptSubmit 结果，因此 retry 仍会运行这个 hook。
- **continue**（继续被打断的轮次）：仍由 ACP 剥离被打断的用户输入，或关闭被打断的调用。第一轮是 `Retry`，带历史标识，和现在一样不运行 UserPromptSubmit。第一条请求一直没有发出时，被打断的那段输入按原样放回。
- **restore**（恢复一个未回答的 `ask_user_question`）：ACP 用自己的工具步骤重新提问。回答作为第一轮发出，即一个 `Retry`，之后的批次使用共享工具批。

重新进入的轮次即使带着工具结果，第一轮也是 `Retry`。`ToolResult` 不会开启 client 的一次交互，上一个 prompt 的循环检测计数会延续下来，UserPromptSubmit 也会在这些结果上运行。client 不给 `Retry` 加系统提醒，所以 ACP 仍然加上 plan、arena 和 output-style 提醒。

被恢复的问题暂时保留 ACP 的工具步骤。共享工具批会记录每一个结果，而因超时没有回答的问题必须保持未记录，之后加载时才能再次提问。

core 的改动：

- `SendMessageOptions.userTurnRecordedByHost` 也覆盖 `Retry`，表示宿主已经启动了它的 todo 工作链。
- `Retry` 也接受 `promptAdmission`。
- 新增输入 `historyPromptId`：`Retry` 的请求在历史中带的标识。它由第一条请求用掉，续发不会带上它。

设置开启时，这些轮次与现在相比有以下差异，已写进设计文档的兼容性一节：

- channel 和 Goal 提案轮次在共享路径上得到与全新 prompt 相同的处理，例如日期提醒、系统提醒和 client 的召回。
- retry、continue 和 restore 会开启 client 的一次交互：循环检测器、探索预算和轮次预算重新开始。它们的第一轮不计入会话轮数上限。
- continue 的第一条请求一直没有发出时，被打断的用户输入按原样放回，而不是作为一条合并后的条目保留。

## 为什么需要

此前只有 channel 和 Goal 提案之外的全新 prompt 使用共享 loop。retry、continue 和 restore 仍走 ACP 旧的发送路径、Stop 循环和工具步骤，channel 和 Goal 提案轮次也一样。每一份副本都需要把 loop 的每个修复再做一遍。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 先执行 `npm run bundle`，再执行 `cd integration-tests && npx vitest run cli/acp-agent-loop-parity.test.ts`。
  - 新增的“读取文件的 channel prompt”和“模型报错之后的 retry”两个场景，在设置关闭和开启时发给模型的请求必须一致，`session/update` 通知和停止原因也必须一致。其余场景必须不变。
- 单元测试：
  - `packages/core` 的 `client.test.ts`：
    - 由 `Retry` 用掉的 admission；
    - 用宿主给出的标识标记 `Retry`；
    - retry 的 todo 工作链交给宿主。
  - `packages/cli` 的 `Session.test.ts`：
    - 共享模型轮上的 channel prompt；
    - guard 让位后提案不启动 Goal；
    - retry 和 continue 以带剥离标识的 `Retry` 发出；
    - 第一条请求在发出前失败或被取消时，剥离的 prompt 只放回一次；
    - 被恢复的问题由 ACP 的执行器回答后以 `Retry` 发出。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用：改动在默认关闭的设置之后，对拍测试会比较两份 loop。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux 本地结果：

- 从全新的 `npm run bundle` 开始：ACP 对拍 21/21，headless 对拍 12/12
- 根目录 `npm run typecheck`（所有 workspace 和 `typecheck:integration`）通过
- core 的 `client.test.ts` 和 `agent-loop.test.ts`：627 个通过
- cli `src/acp-integration/`：3,154 个通过；唯一的失败是 `acp-output.test.ts`，这是本 PR 没有改动的 Node 流测试，不带本 PR 的改动时也以同样方式失败
- 改动文件的 eslint 和 prettier 检查通过

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：retry、continue 和 restore 现在使用 client 的每次交互状态，因此它们的循环检测器和各项预算会重新开始。restore 的第一轮保留 ACP 的执行器，直到后续步骤让共享工具批能够不记录无人应答的回答。设置关闭时没有任何变化。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：Goal 轮次（PR 2c-3），以及 cron 和后台通知轮次（PR 2c-4）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

设计文档：[docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md) 和 [docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md)。两份都新增了 PR 2c-2 一节，扩大了 `userTurnRecordedByHost` 那一行的说明，把 `historyPromptId` 列入输入类选项，并补充了新的 ACP 场景和有意的差异。

## 关联 Issue

#15327 的一部分。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): surface Managed session list failures
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A failed Managed Session list request now stays in the session navigation as a localized load-error notice with a Retry action, instead of becoming a raw sentence at the top of the conversation pane. The notice includes the HTTP status, error code and request ID when the client has them, and the normal empty state no longer appears until a list request has actually succeeded.

The Managed Agent HTTP client now retains the required `request_id` from a JSON error envelope and falls back to the `X-Request-Id` response header for non-JSON gateway failures.

## Why it's needed

Issue #14918 shows a non-JSON 500 rendered as `Managed Agent request failed (500)` in a zh-CN interface, far from the session list that failed and with no recovery action. The same failure displays 暂无托管任务 even though the client never learned whether the user has any Managed Sessions. Dropping the request ID also prevents correlating the failure with server logs.

This PR fixes that list-specific failure path without folding the page's shared submit, detail and restore error channels into the same change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Make the Managed Session list request fail with a JSON HTTP error carrying `error.request_id`. Expected: the session navigation shows a localized load failure, the HTTP status, error code and request ID, plus a Retry button; the conversation pane does not repeat the same raw message and the empty state is absent.
2. Make the list request fail with a non-JSON 500 that includes `X-Request-Id`. Expected: the same localized list failure appears with the response header as its correlation ID.

4. Keep a loaded list visible, make a pagination request fail, and use the list Retry action. Expected: existing rows remain and the failed page can be requested again.

Runtime screenshots were not captured in this pass. The focused regression coverage is included in the diff:

- A non-JSON response falls back to `X-Request-Id`.
- A list failure renders the localized notice with status, code and request ID.
- A failed initial list does not render the empty state and Retry issues a second request.

Changes are limited to the Web Shell client and its i18n catalog. No live Managed Agent deployment was used.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: list failures now use a dedicated state instead of the page-wide error sink. Other request failures keep their existing channels, so this PR intentionally does not make all Managed errors retryable in place.
- Not validated / out of scope: local tests, build, typecheck and formatting were not run. The broader submit/detail error-channel split and layout follow-ups discussed in issue #14918 remain out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): enable external workspace execution
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Builds the external Workspace execution slice on top of the materialization prerequisite in #15654. The branch now includes live `hosted-workspace-external-files/1` admission, bounded and single-query Workspace discovery, authoritative registration checks, stable lifecycle refusal classification, and receipt-backed release for external Runtime bindings. The separate materialization operation still creates metadata only; it does not allocate storage or start a worker.

This revision closes the remaining review gaps in that execution slice: registration decode failures, including field-type failures, now resolve to a permanent `409 workspace_unavailable`; a malformed registration disables only its own Workspace during batch discovery; saved-provider shutdown is classified as retryable `503`; attachment actor lookup fails closed on zero, multiple, or null rows; and external lifecycle authorization preserves the exact permanent fence response.

## Why it's needed

#15512 needs a durable link from registered external storage to a Workspace that can be discovered and used safely. A Session must not become executable through a partially wired path, and one corrupt storage row must not hide every healthy Workspace on the page. The same branch also needs terminal close and recovery paths to distinguish permanent identity failures from provider availability failures.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On an isolated fresh catalog, register external storage using the loopback operator credential, materialize its alias with an owner, and verify that only the owner can discover it. Exercise Session creation after the external-files gates and a Harness lifecycle capability are available. Confirm that prompts can run, file tools remain within the external profile, and close/recovery uses the receipt-backed ownership transition without destroying a shared placement.

For the query and failure paths, corrupt one registration and confirm only that Workspace loses Session-creation eligibility while another Workspace remains visible. Confirm that an admission attempt against the corrupted Workspace returns `409 workspace_unavailable` with `retryable=false`. Shut down the saved external provider during drain-capability checks and confirm a retryable `503`. Submit a non-current lifecycle authority to the external attachment path and confirm `409 workspace_lifecycle_claim_fenced` with `retryable=false`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before this revision, a field-type error while decoding an opaque-persisted registration could escape as a mapper failure, batch discovery could fail as a whole when one row was malformed, and a shut-down saved provider was conflated with a permanent binding conflict. The candidate maps these cases explicitly, uses one registration batch read rather than per-row JDBC work inside a mapper, and keeps external lifecycle fences non-retryable.

Earlier evidence in this stack covered materialization, registration replay, and isolated MySQL validation. The newest commit was checked statically and through the repository's CI gates; no local test, build, or typecheck was run under the requested execution policy.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :---: |
| macOS | ✅ static review and `git diff --check`; no heavy local execution |
| Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| Linux | ✅ repository CI for the branch; the new head is checked again after push |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the authenticated operator delegates the Workspace owner. That field is a grant target, not authenticated user identity. Existing operator and tenant checks remain required.
- Batch discovery now fails closed per malformed storage row instead of failing the whole Workspace page. A failed SQL read remains a retryable provider-unavailable verdict.
- `workspace_lifecycle_claim_fenced` remains permanent. Do not reinterpret a stale or non-current authority as a transient outage.
- Full external Hosted shell/capture, attachment widening beyond the current profile, and the Resident shared-worker behavior remain outside this PR. #16023 carries the Resident and EPHEMERAL layers.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the preceding stack extends the shared V1 catalog under the repository's pre-release fresh-catalog policy. No V2 migration is introduced here.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #15512. Related prerequisite: #15654. The Resident shared-worker increment is stacked in #16023 and must not merge before this PR.

prs.title: fix(cli): show the resolved global directory in the permissions dialogs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The permissions dialog's "User settings" row now names the settings file the running process actually uses. The resolved global settings path is rendered through the existing `Saved in {{path}}` message and shortened to `~` for display, so a default install still reads `~/.qwen/settings.json` while a `QWEN_HOME` install reads its own path; long relocated paths are middle-compressed so the file name stays visible in the row at an 80-column terminal.

Both renderers are updated: the ink dialog and its OpenTUI parity copy. The hardcoded `Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json` message is retired, and `Saved in {{path}}` — which had no entry in any bundled locale, so the memory manager was silently falling back to English for that row — now exists in all nine locales and is listed in `MUST_TRANSLATE_KEYS`, so a future locale sync cannot drop it again without a failing test.

## Why it's needed

Addresses the dialog half of #15628. `Storage.getGlobalSettingsPath()` already honours `QWEN_HOME`, and the permissions dialog was the one place that ignored it: with `QWEN_HOME=/tmp/custom-qwen` the process reads `/tmp/custom-qwen/settings.json` while the User-settings row points at `~/.qwen/settings.json`. Because the row reads the resolved directory rather than a fixed string, it also follows the config-directory move planned in #15458 without another edit.

This is deliberately only the dialog half of the issue. The setting descriptions and the published VS Code schema are untouched: `scripts/generate-settings-schema.ts` copies `setting.description` verbatim into the shipped schema, so interpolating a resolved path there would freeze the build machine's home directory into the artifact, and that half is coupled to #15458 anyway.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `QWEN_HOME=/tmp/custom-qwen npm run dev`, run `/permissions`, open the User settings scope → the row names `/tmp/custom-qwen/settings.json`.
2. Unset `QWEN_HOME`, repeat → the row names `~/.qwen/settings.json`.
3. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/opentui/dialogs-permissions.test.ts src/ui/components/PermissionsDialog.test.tsx src/ui/components/MemoryDialog.test.tsx` → all pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, on the parent commit, with the new assertions in place: `expected 'Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json' to be 'Saved in /var/folders/…/settings.json'` — both scope-item tests failed.

After: 13 tests in the OpenTUI permissions suite, 2 in the ink scope-item suite, and 17 in the memory dialog suite pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Windows was not run; the only platform-sensitive part is the separator, and both tests build their expectations from `path.sep`. The Linux run used a clean `node:22-bookworm` checkout of this branch.

### Environment (optional)

`packages/cli` unit tests on the host, plus the same suite in a `node:22-bookworm` container for the Linux check.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: nine locale entries change, because the old key is retired and the placeholder key is added. Rendering in every bundled language is unchanged for a default install — only the path itself now varies.
- Not validated / out of scope: no interactive TUI screenshot; the rendered description is covered through the exported scope-item helpers rather than through a full dialog render.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: a custom locale pack that translated `Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json` will no longer be consulted for this row; the bundled locales carry the new key.

## Linked Issues

Related to #15628 — this ships the dialog half only. The setting descriptions and the published VS Code schema stay open on the issue until that half lands.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

权限对话框里"用户设置"这一行，现在显示的是进程实际使用的设置文件。解析后的全局设置路径通过已有的 `Saved in {{path}}` 消息渲染，并做 `~` 缩写，因此默认安装仍显示 `~/.qwen/settings.json`，而设置了 `QWEN_HOME` 的安装会显示它自己的路径；被重定向到别处的长路径会做中间段压缩，保证在 80 列终端下文件名仍然可见。

两个渲染器都改了：ink 对话框和它的 OpenTUI 对等实现。硬编码的 `Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json` 消息被退役；而 `Saved in {{path}}` 原本在所有内置语言包里都没有条目，导致记忆管理器的那一行一直在悄悄回落成英文，现在九个语言包都补齐了，并已加入 `MUST_TRANSLATE_KEYS`，将来语言包同步若丢掉它，测试会直接变红。

## 为什么需要

处理 #15628 的对话框这一半。`Storage.getGlobalSettingsPath()` 本来就认 `QWEN_HOME`，权限对话框是唯一忽略它的地方：`QWEN_HOME=/tmp/custom-qwen` 时进程读的是 `/tmp/custom-qwen/settings.json`，而"用户设置"那一行却指向 `~/.qwen/settings.json`。由于这一行改为读取解析后的目录，它也会自动跟随 #15458 计划中的配置目录迁移，不需要再改一次。

这个 PR 刻意只做 issue 的对话框这一半。设置项描述和对外发布的 VS Code schema 没有动：`scripts/generate-settings-schema.ts` 会把 `setting.description` 原样写进发布的 schema，在那里插值会把构建机的 home 目录固化进产物；而且那一半本来就依赖 #15458。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. `QWEN_HOME=/tmp/custom-qwen npm run dev`，执行 `/permissions`，打开"用户设置"作用域 → 该行显示 `/tmp/custom-qwen/settings.json`。
2. 取消 `QWEN_HOME`，重复上述步骤 → 该行显示 `~/.qwen/settings.json`。
3. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/opentui/dialogs-permissions.test.ts src/ui/components/PermissionsDialog.test.tsx src/ui/components/MemoryDialog.test.tsx` → 全部通过。

### 证据（修复前 / 修复后）

修复前（父提交，已带新断言）：`expected 'Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json' to be 'Saved in /var/folders/…/settings.json'` —— 两个作用域断言均失败。

修复后：OpenTUI 权限套件 13 个、ink 作用域套件 2 个、记忆对话框套件 17 个用例全部通过。

### 测试平台

|    系统    | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

Windows 未运行；唯一与平台相关的部分是路径分隔符，两个测试的期望值都由 `path.sep` 拼出。Linux 侧用的是本分支的干净 `node:22-bookworm` 检出。

### 环境（可选）

宿主上跑 `packages/cli` 单测，另在 `node:22-bookworm` 容器里跑同一套用例作为 Linux 验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：九个语言包条目发生变化，因为旧 key 退役、占位符 key 新增。默认安装下各语言的渲染结果不变，变化的只是路径本身。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：没有交互式 TUI 截图；渲染结果通过导出的作用域条目辅助函数覆盖，而非完整对话框渲染。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：自定义语言包（用户 locales 目录）里翻译过 `Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json` 的条目对这一行不再生效，内置语言包已带新 key。

## 关联 issue

关联 #15628（不自动关闭）——本 PR 只做对话框这一半。设置项描述与对外发布的 VS Code schema 仍需在该 issue 上继续跟进，待那一半落地后再关闭。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): match one sed character for . and bracket expressions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The shell tool's in-process sed simulation now compiles substitution patterns with the `s` and `u` flags. This makes `.` match a carriage return and makes character classes and quantifiers operate on Unicode characters instead of UTF-16 code units. A literal `]` outside a bracket expression is escaped during translation so the stricter Unicode mode still accepts patterns such as `[\[\]]`.

## Why it's needed

On CRLF files, `s/=.*$/=new/` matched nothing and the tool reported that the edit made no changes. On files containing astral characters, `s/^.//` removed one half of an emoji and wrote the lone surrogate back as U+FFFD, silently corrupting the file. Real sed treats both cases as one character.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the sed parser unit tests. The new regression case covers the six rows from the issue: astral characters with `.`, a negated class, a zero-width `x*` match, and a CRLF substitution. Before the change it fails on the first astral row; after the change all cases pass. Also confirm that ordinary bracket patterns such as `[abc]`, `[^abc]`, and `[\[\]]` still take the simulation path rather than falling back.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. Unit tests: 53 passed, including new pins for negated, mixed and equivalence-class POSIX forms (`[^[:space:]]`, `[[:alpha:]abc]`, `[[=a=]]`) and for the GNU/BSD multibyte-backreference split. The full core suite passed 39,351 tests; the single `bun-pty.test.ts` failure also reproduces on unmodified main. Typecheck, lint, and formatting pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux was verified in a Docker `node:22-bookworm` arm64 container.

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.4; unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the `u` flag can reject patterns that previously compiled, so those commands now fall back to real sed. That is the existing fail-safe path and never writes a wrong file.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows; GNU sed's zero-width `x*` iteration and multibyte backreferences are bytewise, while BSD sed and this simulation are characterwise. The POSIX-class guard now declines any pattern containing `[:`, `[.` or `[=`, so mixed and negated character classes also fall back to real sed instead of being simulated wrongly.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15675

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

shell 工具的进程内 sed 模拟现在会用 `s` 和 `u` 标志编译替换模式。这样 `.` 能匹配回车符，字符类和量词也按 Unicode 字符而不是 UTF-16 code unit 工作。翻译时会把字符类外的字面量 `]` 转义，保证更严格的 Unicode 模式仍能接受 `[\[\]]` 这类模式。

## 为什么需要

在 CRLF 文件上，`s/=.*$/=new/` 匹配不到任何内容，工具会报告没有产生修改。在包含星平面字符的文件上，`s/^.//` 只删掉 emoji 的一半，并把孤立代理项写成 U+FFFD，静默损坏文件。真实 sed 在两种情况下都按一个字符处理。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 sed 解析器单测。新增回归用例覆盖 issue 里的六行：星平面字符配合 `.`、否定字符类、零宽 `x*` 匹配，以及 CRLF 替换。修改前第一行星平面用例失败，修改后全部通过。同时确认 `[abc]`、`[^abc]`、`[\[\]]` 这类普通字符类仍然走模拟路径，而不是回退。

### 证据（修改前后）

UI 变化：N/A。单测 53 通过，新增取反/混合/等价类 POSIX 形态（`[^[:space:]]`、`[[:alpha:]abc]`、`[[=a=]]`）以及 GNU/BSD 多字节反向引用分歧的钉子。core 全量 39,351 通过；唯一失败的 `bun-pty.test.ts` 在未修改的 main 上也能复现。类型检查、lint、格式化均通过。

### 测试环境

|    系统    | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

Linux 在 Docker `node:22-bookworm` arm64 容器中验证。

### 运行环境（可选）

Node 22.23.4；仅单测。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：`u` 标志会拒绝一些以前能编译的模式，这些命令会回退到真实 sed。这是既有的 fail-safe 路径，不会写错文件。
- 未验证/超出范围：Windows；GNU sed 的零宽 `x*` 与多字节反向引用按字节推进，而 BSD sed 和本模拟按字符推进。POSIX 字符类 guard 现在对含 `[:`、`[.`、`[=` 的模式一律回退，混合与取反写法也不再被错误模拟。

Closes #15675
